nodes.effect: Reaction. Before you roll defense against an adjacent enemy’s melee weapon attack, add 1 Boon to that defense. No separate roll.

nodes.name: Deflecting Parry II
nodes.effect: On a Strong defense, Deflecting Parry lets you move 1 square after the attack without triggering movement reactions.

nodes.name: Deflecting Parry III
nodes.effect: Deflecting Parry works against melee attacks from adjacent enemies using weapons, natural attacks or unarmed strikes.

nodes.name: Answering Steel I
nodes.effect: Reaction · Agility. After an adjacent enemy finishes a melee attack against you, strike it for 1/2/4 physical damage if your defense was Standard or Strong and it remains adjacent.

nodes.name: Answering Steel II
nodes.effect: Answering Steel deals 2/3/5 physical damage.

nodes.name: Answering Steel III
nodes.effect: After a Strong Answering Steel counterattack, you may move 1 square without triggering movement reactions.

nodes.name: Counter in Tempo
nodes.effect: Reaction · Agility. When an adjacent enemy finishes a melee attack against you or an adjacent ally and the defense was Standard or Strong, attack it for 2/4/7 physical damage. On Strong it gains Dazed 1. After your counter, you may move up to 2 squares without triggering movement reactions. You must be able to act and the enemy must still be adjacent.

nodes.name: Bind the Blade I
nodes.effect: Main Action · Agility. Attack an adjacent enemy wielding a melee weapon for 1/2/3 physical damage. On Standard or Strong, that weapon’s next attack takes 1 Bane if made before your next turn starts.

nodes.name: Bind the Blade II
nodes.effect: On Strong, Bind the Blade imposes 2 Banes instead of 1.

nodes.name: Bind the Blade III
nodes.effect: Bind the Blade deals 1/3/4 physical damage.

nodes.name: Strip the Grip I
nodes.effect: Main Action · Agility. Attack an adjacent enemy holding a weapon for 1/3/4 physical damage. On Standard or Strong, choose one of its held weapons. It drops that weapon in its square if it can release it. If it cannot release the weapon, its next attack with it before your next turn starts takes 1 Bane.

nodes.name: Strip the Grip II
nodes.effect: Strip the Grip imposes 2 Banes instead of 1 when you choose a weapon the target cannot release.

nodes.name: Strip the Grip III
nodes.effect: You may move the weapon Strip the Grip dislodges into a legal unoccupied square adjacent to the target instead.

nodes.name: Surrender the Steel
nodes.effect: Main Action · Agility. Once per scene, attack an adjacent enemy holding a weapon for 2/4/6 physical damage. On Standard or Strong it drops one held weapon of your choice if it can release it. Move the dropped weapon up to 2 squares along a clear route to an unoccupied square. On Strong, you may instead guide it up to 2 squares along a clear route into your free hand. On Standard or Strong, if the target cannot release the weapon, it takes 2 Banes on its next attack with that weapon before your next turn starts.

nodes.name: Tactics
nodes.effect: Read the fight, make a plan and put someone in position to use it.

nodes.name: Exploit the Opening I
nodes.effect: Main Action · Knowledge. Attack one visible adjacent enemy for 1/3/4 physical damage. On Standard or Strong, cue one willing ally within 3 squares of you. That ally may move 1 square after the attack, following the usual movement reactions.

nodes.name: Exploit the Opening II
nodes.effect: Exploit the Opening deals 2/4/5 physical damage.

nodes.name: Exploit the Opening III
nodes.effect: Movement granted by Exploit the Opening avoids reactions from the target of your attack.

nodes.name: Divide Their Attention I
nodes.effect: Main Action · Knowledge. Attack one visible adjacent enemy for 2/4/6 physical damage. On Standard or Strong, choose one willing ally within 3 squares. It gains 1 Boon on its next attack against that enemy before your next turn starts.

nodes.name: Divide Their Attention II
nodes.effect: Divide Their Attention deals 3/5/7 physical damage.

nodes.name: Divide Their Attention III
nodes.effect: On Strong, Divide Their Attention may grant its Boon to two willing allies within range.

nodes.name: Spring the Trap
nodes.effect: Main Action · Knowledge. Once per scene, attack a visible adjacent enemy for 4/6/8 physical damage. On Standard or Strong, up to three willing allies within 4 squares may each move 2 squares, avoiding movement reactions from the target. Each gains 1 Boon on its next attack against that target before your next turn starts. On Strong, the target also gains Dazed 1.

nodes.name: Clear the Way I
nodes.effect: Maneuver. Give one willing ally within 3 squares a cue and choose attack or defense. The ally gains 1 Boon on its next roll of that type before your next turn starts. No roll.

nodes.name: Clear the Way II
nodes.effect: Clear the Way reaches up to 5 squares.

nodes.name: Clear the Way III
nodes.effect: Clear the Way can instead cue the ally for a chosen noncombat task. Its next roll for that task gains the Boon during the exchange or work interval. Outside combat, contribute this aid or your own roll to the objective during that interval.

nodes.name: Set the Formation I
nodes.effect: Maneuver · Knowledge. Choose a visible enemy and up to two willing allies within 4 squares. On any result, one chosen ally may move 1 square without triggering movement reactions from that enemy. On Standard or Strong, each chosen ally gains 1 Boon on its next attack against that enemy before your next turn starts.

nodes.name: Set the Formation II
nodes.effect: Set the Formation allows every chosen ally to move the square.

nodes.name: Set the Formation III
nodes.effect: Set the Formation can choose up to three willing allies within range.

nodes.name: The Perfect Moment
nodes.effect: Maneuver · Knowledge. Once per scene, choose a visible enemy and up to three willing allies within 6 squares. Each ally may move 1/2/3 squares without triggering movement reactions from that enemy. Each gains 1 Boon on its next attack against that enemy before your next turn starts, or 2 Boons on Strong.

nodes.name: Call the Warning I
nodes.effect: Reaction. Before a willing ally within 3 squares rolls defense against an attack from an enemy you can see, give it 1 Boon on that defense if it can follow your cue. No separate roll.

nodes.name: Call the Warning II
nodes.effect: Call the Warning reaches up to 5 squares.

nodes.name: Call the Warning III
nodes.effect: After a Strong defense aided by Call the Warning, the ally may move 1 square without triggering movement reactions from that attacker.

nodes.name: On My Signal I
nodes.effect: Reaction. When a visible enemy within 4 squares ends voluntary movement, cue one willing ally within 4 squares. It may move up to 2 squares without triggering movement reactions from that enemy. No roll.

nodes.name: On My Signal II
nodes.effect: On My Signal can cue two willing allies within range.

nodes.name: On My Signal III
nodes.effect: Each ally moving with On My Signal may move up to 3 squares.

nodes.name: Roads Out
nodes.effect: Reaction. Once per scene, when a visible enemy within 6 squares ends voluntary movement, choose up to three willing allies within 6 squares. You and each chosen ally may move up to 3 squares without triggering movement reactions. Each chosen ally gains 1 Boon on its next defense against that enemy before your next turn starts. No roll.

nodes.name: Read the Pattern I
nodes.effect: Maneuver. Observe one visible enemy. Until your next turn starts, gain 1 Boon on the next attack you make against it or the next defense you roll against it, whichever comes first. No roll.

nodes.name: Read the Pattern II
nodes.effect: When you use Read the Pattern, you may first move 1 square. Follow the usual movement reactions.

nodes.name: Read the Pattern III
nodes.effect: You may choose whether to keep the Boon for an attack roll or a defense roll against the chosen enemy when you use Read the Pattern.

nodes.name: Rehearse the Exchange I
nodes.effect: Maneuver · Knowledge. Study one visible enemy. Move up to 1 square, then gain 1 Boon on your next attack or next defense roll against it before your next turn starts. Choose which when you use this technique. On Strong, you may move up to 2 squares instead. Follow the usual movement reactions.

nodes.name: Rehearse the Exchange II
nodes.effect: Rehearse the Exchange gives 2 Boons instead of 1 on Strong.

nodes.name: Rehearse the Exchange III
nodes.effect: Movement from Rehearse the Exchange avoids movement reactions from the chosen enemy.

nodes.name: Three Moves Ahead
nodes.effect: Maneuver · Knowledge. Once per scene, choose up to two visible enemies. Move up to 2/3/4 squares without triggering movement reactions from them. Until your next turn starts, gain 2 Boons on your next attack against a chosen enemy and 1 Boon on your next defense against a chosen enemy. These are two distinct rolls. Taking this stance replaces any unused Boons from your other Tactics techniques.

nodes.name: Armor
nodes.effect: Wear your protection as though it were part of you.

nodes.name: Armored Advance I
nodes.effect: Main Action. Move up to your Speed along a legal route. Ignore the extra movement cost of the first square of nonmagical difficult terrain on this move. Gain Stability 1 until your next turn starts. No roll.

nodes.name: Armored Advance II
nodes.effect: Armored Advance ignores the extra cost of the first two squares of nonmagical difficult terrain on this move.

nodes.name: Armored Advance III
nodes.effect: Armored Advance grants Stability 2 instead of 1.

nodes.name: Ironbound Advance I
nodes.effect: Main Action. Move up to your Speed, ignoring extra movement cost from nonmagical difficult terrain. Until your next turn starts, gain Stability 2 and reduce damage from attacks against you by 1 after resistance.

nodes.name: Ironbound Advance II
nodes.effect: Ironbound Advance grants Stability 3.

nodes.name: Ironbound Advance III
nodes.effect: Ironbound Advance reduces attack damage by 2 instead of 1.

nodes.name: The Unbroken Gate
nodes.effect: Main Action, with a held shield. Until your next turn starts, hold your position: you cannot move or be forcibly moved. Once during this stance, when an attacker chooses an adjacent ally as the sole target, you may become the target before the roll if you are a legal target. This interception costs no Reaction. During the stance, reduce attack damage against you by 3 after resistance. Once per scene, when you establish the stance, up to four willing allies within 3 squares may move 2 squares toward you without movement reactions.

nodes.name: Brace I
nodes.effect: Maneuver. While on solid footing, brace yourself to gain Stability 1 until your next turn starts. No roll.

nodes.name: Brace II
nodes.effect: Brace grants Stability 2.

nodes.name: Brace III
nodes.effect: While Brace lasts, a push or pull that Stability reduces to 0 also fails to knock you Prone; its damage and other effects still apply.

nodes.name: Stand Like Stone I
nodes.effect: Maneuver. Until your next turn starts, gain Stability 3 and cannot be moved against your will or knocked Prone while standing on a supporting surface. You cannot move voluntarily during this stance. No roll.

nodes.name: Stand Like Stone II
nodes.effect: While Stand Like Stone lasts, one willing adjacent ally also gains Stability 1 while adjacent.

nodes.name: Stand Like Stone III
nodes.effect: Stand Like Stone can protect two willing adjacent allies, and gives each Stability 2 while adjacent.

nodes.name: Rooted against the Charge
nodes.effect: Maneuver. Brace a passage up to 3 squares wide while on solid footing. Until your next turn starts, you and up to three willing adjacent allies cannot be forcibly moved or knocked Prone while you remain stationary and they remain adjacent. Each protected creature reduces collision damage by 3 after resistance; this non-attack damage may reach 0. This does not prevent other damage or let creatures pass through blocked squares.

nodes.name: Turn the Blow I
nodes.effect: Reaction. After your defense roll, before physical damage from that attack is applied, reduce its physical damage by 1 after resistance. No roll.

nodes.name: Turn the Blow II
nodes.effect: Turn the Blow reduces physical damage by 2.

nodes.name: Turn the Blow III
nodes.effect: Turn the Blow reduces physical damage by 3.

nodes.name: Weather the Storm I
nodes.effect: Reaction. After your defense roll, before damage from that attack is applied, reduce its damage by 2 after resistance. Until your next turn starts, also reduce physical damage from each later attack against you by 1 after resistance.

nodes.name: Weather the Storm II
nodes.effect: Weather the Storm reduces the triggering attack’s damage by 3 instead of 2.

nodes.name: Weather the Storm III
nodes.effect: Weather the Storm reduces later physical attack damage by 2 instead of 1.

nodes.name: Unyielding Shell
nodes.effect: Reaction. After your defense roll, before damage from that attack is applied, reduce its damage by 4 after resistance. Until your next turn starts, reduce damage from each further attack against you by 3 after resistance. Once per scene, this response also prevents new Bleeding and Dazed from the triggering attack; its other effects remain.

nodes.name: Light Armor I
nodes.effect: Passive. You are trained to wear light armor; the suit supplies physical resistance 1. Ignore 1 Bulk from worn armor when calculating encumbrance, minimum 0 armor Bulk. This does not change its inventory size.

nodes.name: Light Armor II
nodes.effect: While wearing armor you are trained to use, gain 1 Boon on rolls to resist forced movement. This is not additional resistance or Stability.

nodes.name: Light Armor III
nodes.effect: You are also trained to wear medium armor; the suit supplies physical resistance 2. Your Speed increases by 1 while wearing armor you are trained to use.

nodes.name: Heavy Armor I
nodes.effect: Passive. You are also trained to wear heavy armor; the suit supplies physical resistance 3. Maneuver: lift one willing or helpless adjacent creature no larger than you. For this turn, carrying it adds no encumbrance and occupies no weapon hand. Put it down in a legal adjacent square when your turn ends.

nodes.name: Heavy Armor II
nodes.effect: While wearing trained armor, ignore the extra cost of the first square of nonmagical difficult terrain you enter each turn. Heavy Armor’s carrying benefit lasts until the start of your next turn instead of turn end.

nodes.name: Heavy Armor III
nodes.effect: Heavy Armor’s carrying Maneuver also lets you move 2 squares with the passenger without movement reactions. Place the passenger in a legal adjacent square when the carrying benefit ends.

nodes.name: Bring Everyone Home
nodes.effect: Main Action · Knowledge, wearing trained armor and holding a shield, with medical supplies. Once per scene, move up to 8 squares without movement reactions. Along the route treat up to three different willing or helpless creatures within reach: roll once; each with an available first-aid attempt restores 5/8/11 HP and spends that attempt. Carry one creature no larger than you along any part of the route without added encumbrance or using your shield hand; place it adjacent at the end. A spent allowance still permits rescue, not healing. Supplies must cover each treated patient.

nodes.name: Guard
nodes.effect: Be where someone needs you before they have to ask.

nodes.name: Shield Bash I
nodes.effect: Main Action · Brawn. Attack one adjacent creature with your shield for 1/2/3 physical damage. On Standard or Strong, push it 1 square directly away. Resolve collisions normally.

nodes.name: Shield Bash II
nodes.effect: Shield Bash deals 2/3/4 physical damage.

nodes.name: Shield Bash III
nodes.effect: Shield Bash also knocks its target Prone on Strong after the push.

nodes.name: Break the Line I
nodes.effect: Main Action · Brawn. Attack up to two adjacent enemies. Roll once; each takes 1/2/3 physical damage and is pushed 1 square directly away. Resolve collisions normally.

nodes.name: Break the Line II
nodes.effect: Break the Line deals 2/3/4 physical damage.

nodes.name: Break the Line III
nodes.effect: Break the Line pushes 2 squares instead of 1; on Strong each target also becomes Prone.

nodes.name: Shatter the Formation
nodes.effect: Main Action · Brawn, with a melee weapon and shield. Attack up to three adjacent enemies. Roll once; each takes 2/4/6 physical damage and is pushed up to 2 squares directly away. On Strong each also becomes Prone. Blocked movement stops the push, not damage or Prone; resolve collisions normally. Each target is struck once.

nodes.name: Sheltering Guard I
nodes.effect: Maneuver. Choose one willing adjacent ally. Until your next turn starts it gains 1 Boon on ranged defenses while adjacent. Reusing this technique replaces its previous effect. No roll.

nodes.name: Sheltering Guard II
nodes.effect: Sheltering Guard can protect two adjacent allies.

nodes.name: Sheltering Guard III
nodes.effect: Sheltering Guard also gives each protected ally Stability 1 while adjacent.

nodes.name: Shield Canopy I
nodes.effect: Maneuver. Until your next turn starts, you and up to three willing adjacent allies reduce ranged attack damage by 2 after resistance while they remain adjacent. Reusing this technique replaces its previous effect. No roll.

nodes.name: Shield Canopy II
nodes.effect: When you use Shield Canopy, you may first move 1 square toward an ally without movement reactions; choose protected allies after moving.

nodes.name: Shield Canopy III
nodes.effect: Shield Canopy also gives its protected creatures 1 Boon on melee defense while they remain adjacent.

nodes.name: The Moving Bulwark
nodes.effect: Maneuver. Once per scene, choose up to four willing allies within 3 squares who can perceive your signal. You and each chosen ally may move 2 squares without movement reactions. Until your next turn starts, you and chosen allies within 3 squares gain 1 Boon on defense and reduce attack damage by 3 after resistance. Leaving range suspends the protection until returning. No roll.

nodes.name: Interpose I
nodes.effect: Reaction. After an adjacent ally rolls defense, before applying physical damage from that attack, reduce that damage by 1 after resistance. You must be able to reach the ally. No roll.

nodes.name: Interpose II
nodes.effect: Interpose reduces physical damage by 2.

nodes.name: Interpose III
nodes.effect: Before Interpose you may move 1 square to reach the ally without movement reactions.

nodes.name: Take the Blow I
nodes.effect: Reaction. Before an adjacent ally rolls defense against a single-target attack, become its target if the attacker can legally target you. Roll your defense and receive all effects; the ally receives none.

nodes.name: Take the Blow II
nodes.effect: Before Take the Blow you may move up to 2 squares without movement reactions to reach an ally within 2 squares. Become a legal target before substituting.

nodes.name: Take the Blow III
nodes.effect: When you use Take the Blow, gain 1 Boon on your defense. After the intercepted attack resolves, the attacker’s remaining voluntary movement this turn becomes 0. Forced movement still applies.

nodes.name: The Last Safe Step
nodes.effect: Reaction. When an ally within 4 squares is about to take damage from an attack or fall, move up to 4 squares to reach it. If you reach it, move together up to 2 more squares and reduce that damage by 4 after resistance. Neither creature triggers movement reactions during this rescue. An attack still resolves against its original target; a fall ends only if the destination supports both creatures. Fall damage can reach 0. No roll beyond the original defense.

nodes.name: Guarded Passage I
nodes.effect: Reaction. Before an adjacent ally rolls defense against a reaction triggered by its movement, grant that defense 1 Boon. No roll.

nodes.name: Guarded Passage II
nodes.effect: Guarded Passage grants 2 Boons instead of 1.

nodes.name: Guarded Passage III
nodes.effect: Guarded Passage also reduces damage from that reaction by 1 after resistance.

nodes.name: Rescue Step I
nodes.effect: Maneuver. Move up to 2 squares to a willing ally, then move with it up to 2 more squares. Both creatures ignore movement reactions during this movement and finish adjacent. You can carry a helpless ally no larger than you instead, with a free hand and normal carrying limits. No roll.

nodes.name: Rescue Step II
nodes.effect: Rescue Step’s initial approach may cover 3 squares instead of 2.

nodes.name: Rescue Step III
nodes.effect: Rescue Step may escort two willing allies together, each starting and finishing adjacent to you; alternatively carry one helpless ally as before.

nodes.name: The Long Road
nodes.effect: Main Action. Once per scene, guide up to four willing allies initially within 3 squares along legal routes up to 6 squares each, moving up to 6 squares yourself. All ignore movement reactions and must finish within 3 squares of you. Instead of one willing traveler, carry a helpless creature no larger than you, without additional encumbrance for this move; place it adjacent afterward. This does not heal or stabilize. No roll.

nodes.name: Marksmanship
nodes.effect: Find the line between your hand and a distant mark.

nodes.name: Measured Shot I
nodes.effect: Main Action · Agility. Attack one creature within 8 squares for 2/3/5 physical damage.

nodes.name: Measured Shot II
nodes.effect: Measured Shot deals 3/4/6 physical damage.

nodes.name: Measured Shot III
nodes.effect: Measured Shot has range 12 squares.

nodes.name: Split the Flight I
nodes.effect: Main Action · Agility. Attack up to three creatures within 8 squares. Roll once; each takes 1/2/4 physical damage. Each is struck once.

nodes.name: Split the Flight II
nodes.effect: Split the Flight has range 12 squares.

nodes.name: Split the Flight III
nodes.effect: Split the Flight deals 2/3/5 physical damage. You may also spend a Main Action observing one visible creature within 12 squares to mark a vulnerable part of its anatomy or construction for this scene; no roll. The DA identifies a plausible exposed part, or states that none is visible.

nodes.name: Anatomist’s Volley
nodes.effect: Main Action · Agility. Attack up to three enemies within 12 squares. Roll once. Each takes 3/5/8 physical damage. For a target whose vulnerable part you know from Split the Flight’s study or evidence, apply that hit ignoring up to 2 physical resistance. Apply immunity and other reductions normally.

nodes.name: Hobbling Aim I
nodes.effect: Maneuver. Choose one visible creature within 8 squares. Your next Main Action ranged or thrown attack against it before this turn ends also applies Slowed 1 on Standard or Strong. This modifies one target of one attack. Reusing this technique replaces its unused effect.

nodes.name: Hobbling Aim II
nodes.effect: On Strong, Hobbling Aim applies Slowed 2 instead of 1.

nodes.name: Hobbling Aim III
nodes.effect: On Weak, Hobbling Aim also applies Slowed 1.

nodes.name: Hold the Pass I
nodes.effect: Maneuver. Choose up to two visible creatures within 8 squares. Before your turn ends, your next Main Action ranged or thrown attack applies Slowed 1 to each chosen creature it attacks, on any result. This grants no extra targets or attacks and replaces Hobbling Aim for that attack.

nodes.name: Hold the Pass II
nodes.effect: Hold the Pass can choose creatures within 12 squares.

nodes.name: Hold the Pass III
nodes.effect: Hold the Pass applies Slowed 2 instead of 1 to those targets.

nodes.name: Close the Escape
nodes.effect: Maneuver. Once per scene, choose up to three visible creatures within 12 squares. Your next Main Action ranged or thrown attack this turn applies Slowed 2 to each chosen creature it attacks; on Strong their voluntary movement becomes 0 until the end of their next turns. Forced movement still applies. This replaces Hold the Pass or Hobbling Aim on that attack and grants no extra targets.

nodes.name: Watchful Shot I
nodes.effect: Reaction · Agility. When a visible enemy within 6 squares finishes voluntary movement, attack it for 1/2/3 physical damage after that movement.

nodes.name: Watchful Shot II
nodes.effect: Watchful Shot has range 8 squares.

nodes.name: Watchful Shot III
nodes.effect: Watchful Shot deals 1/2/4 physical damage. It can also respond when a visible enemy finishes forced movement within range.

nodes.name: Covering Fire I
nodes.effect: Reaction · Agility. When an ally within 4 squares begins voluntary movement, attack one visible enemy within 8 squares for 1/2/4 physical damage before that movement. That ally’s first 2 squares of this movement trigger no reactions from that enemy.

nodes.name: Covering Fire II
nodes.effect: Covering Fire has attack range 12 squares and can protect an ally within 6 squares.

nodes.name: Covering Fire III
nodes.effect: Covering Fire deals 2/3/5 physical damage and protects that ally’s first 3 squares from the target’s movement reactions.

nodes.name: Hunt at the Crossroads
nodes.effect: Main Action · 10 minutes. Prepare an ambush along a trail you have followed, at a site you have surveyed by actually examining its routes and sight lines. Choose up to four willing allies and a visible trigger line up to 6 squares long. Once before your next safe overnight rest, when a tracked enemy crosses the line, you and each chosen ally may spend an available Reaction to make one known basic attack against it if in range. These attacks gain 1 Boon and +2 damage. Preparation ends if you leave the site. Resolve awareness and initiative normally; preparation grants no additional surprise turn.

nodes.name: Hurl I
nodes.effect: Main Action · Agility. Throw one held weapon at a creature within 4 squares for 2/3/5 physical damage.

nodes.name: Hurl II
nodes.effect: Hurl has range 6 squares.

nodes.name: Hurl III
nodes.effect: After Hurl, draw one accessible replacement weapon without spending an action. This does not retrieve the thrown weapon.

nodes.name: Ricochet I
nodes.effect: Main Action · Agility. Throw one weapon at two creatures within 4 squares of you and 2 squares of each other. Roll once; each takes 1/2/4 physical damage. The weapon lands beside the second target.

nodes.name: Ricochet II
nodes.effect: Ricochet has range 6 squares from you; its targets must still be within 2 squares of each other.

nodes.name: Ricochet III
nodes.effect: Ricochet deals 2/3/5 physical damage to each target.

nodes.name: Steel across the Gap
nodes.effect: Main Action · Agility. Jump up to 4 squares to a visible legal landing without movement reactions. At any point during the jump, throw one held weapon at up to two visible enemies within 6 squares of you and 2 squares of each other. Roll once; each takes 3/5/7 physical damage. The weapon lands beside the second target, or beside the only target if there is one.

nodes.name: Athletics
nodes.effect: Find a way where the easy road ends.

nodes.name: Sure Ascent I
nodes.effect: Main Action. Climb up to 2 squares along a surface with usable holds, paying no movement. If danger requires a roll, use Brawn or Agility as appropriate with 1 Boon; a Weak result advances at least 1 square where passage is physically possible, with the DA’s stated complication. You also gain that Boon on ordinary climbing rolls.

nodes.name: Sure Ascent II
nodes.effect: Sure Ascent lets you climb at 1 square per movement spent during ordinary movement. Its Main Action climbs up to 3 squares.

nodes.name: Sure Ascent III
nodes.effect: You may keep one hand free while stationary on a climb with usable holds. Sure Ascent’s Main Action climbs up to 4 squares.

nodes.name: A Line for Everyone I
nodes.effect: Main Action, with rope and a secure anchor within reach. Rig a line up to 10 squares long. Up to six creatures may climb it at normal movement cost while secured. The rope must reach the route and does not bridge unsupported open space. No roll.

nodes.name: A Line for Everyone II
nodes.effect: A Line for Everyone can rig up to 15 squares of carried rope; creatures using it gain 1 Boon on climbing rolls for remaining hazards.

nodes.name: A Line for Everyone III
nodes.effect: A Line for Everyone can serve up to ten creatures. With secure anchors at both ends that you can physically reach, it can form a supported crossing over open space; it needs enough rope and supports for the load.

nodes.name: The Living Bridge
nodes.effect: Main Action. With a sound rope secured to an anchor you can reach, brace a crossing up to 20 squares long that you have physically established. Until you move, release it or become unable to act, up to eight willing creatures can each traverse the line at normal movement cost with 2 Boons on any required climbing or balance rolls. You may support a load totaling up to twice your normal carrying capacity; greater loads require additional supports. The route and anchor must bear that load.

nodes.name: Running Vault I
nodes.effect: Maneuver. After moving at least 2 squares this turn, jump up to 2 squares horizontally to a visible unoccupied landing. Spend no additional movement. Movement reactions apply.

nodes.name: Running Vault II
nodes.effect: Running Vault reaches up to 3 squares.

nodes.name: Running Vault III
nodes.effect: Running Vault ignores movement reactions during the jump.

nodes.name: Follow My Leap I
nodes.effect: Maneuver. Use Running Vault and guide one willing adjacent ally through the same jump immediately after you. It lands adjacent to your destination; both landings must be legal.

nodes.name: Follow My Leap II
nodes.effect: Follow My Leap reaches up to 4 squares horizontally.

nodes.name: Follow My Leap III
nodes.effect: Follow My Leap can guide two willing adjacent allies through the jump, each to a different legal square adjacent to your destination.

nodes.name: Bounding Company
nodes.effect: Maneuver. Once per scene, after moving at least 2 squares, leap up to 5 squares horizontally and guide up to four willing allies initially within 2 squares through the same crossing. Each lands within 2 squares of your landing in a separate legal square. These jumps trigger no movement reactions. All travelers must be able to move; this grants no flight beyond the landing.

nodes.name: Catch Your Balance I
nodes.effect: Reaction. When you would fall Prone and can move, remain standing instead. No roll.

nodes.name: Catch Your Balance II
nodes.effect: Catch Your Balance can also catch a secure ledge within reach when you begin to fall, leaving you hanging instead. You need a free hand.

nodes.name: Catch Your Balance III
nodes.effect: After Catch Your Balance, you may move 1 square to a safe unoccupied surface within reach without movement reactions.

nodes.name: Catch Them Falling I
nodes.effect: Reaction. Use a free hand to catch one adjacent falling creature no larger than you. From secure footing, bring it into a free adjacent square. You can instead hang together from a reachable hold that supports you both. No roll.

nodes.name: Catch Them Falling II
nodes.effect: Before Catch Them Falling, move 1 square along a safe surface without movement reactions to reach the falling creature.

nodes.name: Catch Them Falling III
nodes.effect: Catch Them Falling can catch a creature one Size larger than you when your footing and anchor support both creatures.

nodes.name: Defy the Fall
nodes.effect: Reaction. When a rope-linked group begins to fall, secure its rope to an anchor within reach or hold it yourself. Arrest the falls of up to four connected creatures whose combined weight the rope and anchor can bear; if holding it yourself, the load cannot exceed twice your normal carrying capacity. They hang from the rope and take no damage from this arrested fall. Spend a Main Action on each following turn to hold it yourself; releasing or losing the support resumes the fall. No roll.

nodes.name: Strong Swimmer I
nodes.effect: Passive. Gain 1 Boon on Brawn rolls to swim.

nodes.name: Strong Swimmer II
nodes.effect: Strong Swimmer removes extra movement cost for swimming in calm water.

nodes.name: Strong Swimmer III
nodes.effect: You may tow one willing or helpless creature no larger than you without additional swimming movement cost.

nodes.name: Carry Them to Shore I
nodes.effect: Main Action · Brawn. Swim up to 2/3/4 squares, towing one willing or helpless adjacent creature no larger than you. The current must permit passage; the passenger moves with you.

nodes.name: Carry Them to Shore II
nodes.effect: Carry Them to Shore swims 3/4/5 squares.

nodes.name: Carry Them to Shore III
nodes.effect: Carry Them to Shore can tow two willing or helpless adjacent creatures, each no larger than you, using a hand or sound tether for each.

nodes.name: Against the Flood
nodes.effect: Main Action · Brawn. Swim up to 4/6/8 squares through passable water, towing up to four willing or helpless creatures on sound tethers. Their combined load cannot exceed twice your carrying capacity. During this movement you and those passengers gain 2 Boons on rolls against the current or floating debris. This does not provide air or protection from unrelated attacks.

nodes.name: Subterfuge
nodes.effect: Work between what people notice and what they assume.

nodes.name: Patient Hand I
nodes.effect: Main Action · Guile, with lock tools. Examine and manipulate one reachable simple nonmagical fastening; add 1/2/3 progress toward opening it. The DA fixes the objective and work interval first: an intricate lock takes 10 minutes per attempt instead of a Main Action. Impossible mechanisms require another approach.

nodes.name: Patient Hand II
nodes.effect: Patient Hand adds 1/3/4 progress.

nodes.name: Patient Hand III
nodes.effect: Patient Hand takes 5 minutes rather than 10 on intricate locks.

nodes.name: Open under Pressure I
nodes.effect: Main Action · Guile, with lock tools. Work on a reachable nonmagical lock with accessible workings. Add 1/2/3 progress toward opening it.

nodes.name: Open under Pressure II
nodes.effect: Open under Pressure adds 1/3/4 progress.

nodes.name: Open under Pressure III
nodes.effect: Open under Pressure gains 1 Boon when you have both lock and repair tools at hand.

nodes.name: Silent Entry
nodes.effect: Main Action · Guile for a simple fastening, or 1 minute for an intricate mechanism, with lock and repair tools. Add 3/5/7 progress toward opening one reachable nonmagical door, lock or fastening without visible damage. At completion you can close it to appear undisturbed to casual inspection. Separate alarms and traps remain separate tasks.

nodes.name: Light Fingers I
nodes.effect: Maneuver · Guile, with a free hand. Palm or plant one unattended palm-sized object within reach; add 1/2/3 progress toward doing so unnoticed. The DA sets the objective and whether scrutiny permits the attempt. The object moves when that objective completes.

nodes.name: Light Fingers II
nodes.effect: Light Fingers adds 1/3/4 progress.

nodes.name: Light Fingers III
nodes.effect: Light Fingers can also target an accessible object worn or carried by a distracted creature, other than a held weapon, secured container or worn armor.

nodes.name: Switch the Prize I
nodes.effect: Maneuver · Guile. Exchange a reachable palm-sized object with a similar object you carry. Use Light Fingers’ requirements and add 1/3/4 progress toward this single unnoticed-exchange objective. The exchange occurs on completion.

nodes.name: Switch the Prize II
nodes.effect: Switch the Prize gains 1 Boon when the replacement has been prepared to closely resemble the original.

nodes.name: Switch the Prize III
nodes.effect: Switch the Prize can exchange an object up to the size of a closed book if you have two free hands and a suitable distraction; other restrictions remain.

nodes.name: The Perfect Substitution
nodes.effect: Maneuver · Guile during an ongoing conversation. Engage a listener who understands you while exchanging an accessible palm-sized object within reach for a similar object you carry. Roll once; add 2/4/6 progress to separately established deception and unnoticed-exchange objectives. The exchange occurs only when its own objective completes. Once per exchange, with a new plausible statement or distraction; repeating it unchanged gives no progress. Held weapons, armor and secured containers remain excluded.

nodes.name: Catch the Click I
nodes.effect: Reaction. When you see a nonmagical trap begin to trigger, warn one creature within 3 squares that can perceive you before its defense or avoidance roll; that roll gains 1 Boon. Once per triggering event. You can also inspect a suspected reachable trap for 1 minute, rolling Reason for 1/2/3 progress to identify its trigger and danger.

nodes.name: Catch the Click II
nodes.effect: Catch the Click’s inspection adds 1/3/4 progress; its warning reaches 6 squares.

nodes.name: Catch the Click III
nodes.effect: After identifying a trap through that inspection, gain 1 Boon on Guile rolls to disarm it with suitable tools.

nodes.name: Turn the Trap I
nodes.effect: Reaction. When you notice a nonmagical trap trigger, guide one willing adjacent creature 1 square to a legal destination before the trap resolves. You can instead shift a reachable trigger you understand with tools in hand. This movement triggers no movement reactions; the trap then resolves normally at its actual area. Once per triggering event. You can also reconfigure an identified trap with 10 minutes and tools: roll Guile for 1/2/3 progress; completion establishes one reachable trigger or safe bypass without increasing damage or scale.

nodes.name: Turn the Trap II
nodes.effect: Turn the Trap’s reconfiguration adds 1/3/4 progress.

nodes.name: Turn the Trap III
nodes.effect: Turn the Trap can guide two willing adjacent creatures 1 square each before resolution, with separate legal destinations. Reaction: before your defense against an adjacent sighted attacker, scatter carried sand or grit with a free hand to gain 1 Boon on that defense. Consume the handful; once per attacker per scene. This grants no blindness condition and does not work on a creature that does not rely on sight.

nodes.name: Read the Killing Ground
nodes.effect: Main Action · 10 minutes · Reason. Survey a visible area up to 6 squares across; add 3/5/7 progress to identify accessible nonmagical traps, triggers and a safe route. Completion reveals supported findings and inaccessible gaps. Companions following your exact unchanged route avoid triggering its identified traps. Reaction: when a companion within 6 squares starts to leave that route toward an identified trigger, warn it before the step; if it perceives you, it may cancel that step and choose another legal step using the same movement. Once per misstep; no extra movement.

nodes.name: Quiet Passage I
nodes.effect: Passive. Gain 1 Boon on Agility rolls to move quietly while concealed. Concealment needs cover or a plausible distraction.

nodes.name: Quiet Passage II
nodes.effect: Quiet Passage removes extra movement cost imposed solely by sneaking.

nodes.name: Quiet Passage III
nodes.effect: Quiet Passage extends its Boon to one willing adjacent companion moving with you through the same concealment.

nodes.name: Vanish into Cover I
nodes.effect: Maneuver · Agility. Move up to 2 squares into cover, then add 1/2/3 progress toward evading pursuers. Become Hidden when the DA’s objective completes and concealment is plausible.

nodes.name: Vanish into Cover II
nodes.effect: Vanish into Cover adds 1/3/4 progress.

nodes.name: Vanish into Cover III
nodes.effect: Vanish into Cover moves up to 3 squares; this movement triggers no movement reactions from creatures that cannot see you when you begin moving.

nodes.name: The Hidden Road
nodes.effect: Main Action · 1 hour · Agility, with rope and concealment materials. Establish a concealed route up to 20 squares long across terrain you can physically traverse; add 3/5/7 progress toward the DA’s route objective. On completion, up to six companions following your instructions can traverse it at normal movement cost with 2 Boons to remain unnoticed. It creates no unsupported bridge. Discovery or damage ends these benefits until the route is repaired and concealed again.

nodes.name: Wilderness
nodes.effect: Read a living landscape and find your place within it.

nodes.name: Read the Trail I
nodes.effect: Main Action · Reason. Read tracks or signs immediately before you; add 1/2/3 progress toward identifying direction, approximate numbers and freshness. Following a trail to the next landmark takes 10 minutes per attempt instead. The DA defines each objective from accessible evidence.

nodes.name: Read the Trail II
nodes.effect: Read the Trail adds 1/3/4 progress.

nodes.name: Read the Trail III
nodes.effect: Read the Trail takes 5 minutes per attempt when following a trail.

nodes.name: Cut Them Off I
nodes.effect: Main Action · Reason to interpret a visible junction on a readable trail, or 10 minutes to scout a wider interception route. Add 1/2/3 progress toward finding a physically feasible interception. Completion reveals the route and travel time, not a guarantee of arriving first.

nodes.name: Cut Them Off II
nodes.effect: Cut Them Off adds 1/3/4 progress.

nodes.name: Cut Them Off III
nodes.effect: After completing Cut Them Off, you and up to four companions gain 1 Boon on travel rolls to traverse that identified route until its next landmark. Changed or blocked terrain requires a new route.

nodes.name: Unerring Pursuit
nodes.effect: Main Action · Reason at a visible junction, or 10 minutes to scout the surrounding area. From a trail you can read, add 3/5/7 progress toward predicting the quarry’s next reachable landmark from its tracks and known terrain. Completion identifies the best-supported destination and gaps in the evidence. You and up to six companions gain 2 Boons on pursuit and traversal rolls along that route until reaching it. This does not locate a quarry that left no readable evidence.

nodes.name: Gentle Hand I
nodes.effect: Maneuver · Reason. Reassure one nonmagical animal within 2 squares that can perceive you and add 1/2/3 progress toward calming its fear. Spend a Maneuver with a receptive animal or 1 minute per attempt with a wary or agitated one. Find an approach it can respond to in the circumstances.

nodes.name: Gentle Hand II
nodes.effect: Gentle Hand adds 1/3/4 progress.

nodes.name: Gentle Hand III
nodes.effect: Gentle Hand may address three animals sharing the same cause of agitation as one objective.

nodes.name: Lead the Herd I
nodes.effect: Maneuver · Reason. Direct up to six calm nonmagical animals already cooperating with you toward a visible safe route; add 1/2/3 progress to the DA’s handling objective. Establishing initial cooperation takes 10 minutes per attempt instead. Completion gets them moving with you; danger or mistreatment ends cooperation.

nodes.name: Lead the Herd II
nodes.effect: Lead the Herd adds 1/3/4 progress.

nodes.name: Lead the Herd III
nodes.effect: Lead the Herd can guide twelve calm animals, and you gain 1 Boon on handling rolls to keep that herd together in ordinary travel.

nodes.name: Wild Accord
nodes.effect: Maneuver · Reason. Give up to twelve nonmagical animals that can perceive you one understandable direction: follow, wait, scatter to safety or approach a named visible place. For a group that needs coaxing, add 3/5/7 progress to the DA’s handling objective. A group already cooperating follows a safe instruction without a roll. Completion gets the group carrying out that direction. This grants no attacks or additional combat turns; serious danger or mistreatment ends cooperation.

nodes.name: Trail Warning I
nodes.effect: Reaction. When a visible natural hazard begins to threaten a companion within 3 squares, before its avoidance roll, warn it. If it can perceive you, that roll gains 1 Boon. The hazard must be something you can observe, such as shifting footing or a falling branch. Once per hazard event.

nodes.name: Trail Warning II
nodes.effect: Trail Warning reaches 6 squares.

nodes.name: Trail Warning III
nodes.effect: Trail Warning may aid two companions affected by the same hazard, each before its roll.

nodes.name: Turn Back the Danger I
nodes.effect: Reaction. When a visible natural hazard is about to affect one willing companion within 3 squares, guide it up to 1 square along a legal safe route before resolution if it perceives you. This triggers no movement reactions. Resolve the hazard at its actual location afterward; it gains 1 Boon on any remaining avoidance roll. Once per hazard event.

nodes.name: Turn Back the Danger II
nodes.effect: Turn Back the Danger reaches 6 squares.

nodes.name: Turn Back the Danger III
nodes.effect: Turn Back the Danger can guide two willing companions, each to a separate legal square, and grants 2 Boons to their remaining avoidance rolls.

nodes.name: Safe Passage
nodes.effect: Reaction. When one visible natural hazard threatens a group within 6 squares, warn up to six willing companions who can perceive you. Each may move up to 2 squares along a legal route you can see before the hazard resolves, without movement reactions. Each gains 2 Boons on any remaining avoidance roll against that event. Once per hazard event; it does not cancel the hazard, cross impassable terrain or reveal hidden threats.

nodes.name: Wild Harvest I
nodes.effect: Main Action · 1 hour · Knowledge. Search an accessible area for food or drinkable water. The DA defines the area and confirms a plausible source before you roll. Raise one Food Bundle or Water Flask of the chosen type by 1/2/3 supply die steps, maximum d8. An empty supply starts at d4 on the first step. You can also spend 1 hour with available materials to shelter two people from ordinary rain and wind, without a roll.

nodes.name: Wild Harvest II
nodes.effect: Wild Harvest raises the supply by 2/3/4 steps, maximum d8. Its ordinary shelter accommodates four people.

nodes.name: Wild Harvest III
nodes.effect: When you find both sources, Wild Harvest can raise one Food Bundle and one Water Flask in the same hour. Apply the rolled steps to each. Its ordinary shelter takes 30 minutes.

nodes.name: A Camp without a Trace I
nodes.effect: Main Action · 30 minutes · Guile. Conceal a completed camp and its approach; add 1/2/3 progress to the DA’s concealment objective. Completion hides casual signs; direct search remains possible. You can also search water-bearing terrain for 1 hour, rolling Reason for 1/2/3 progress toward finding a concealed spring; completion reveals its location and visible hazards, not purification.

nodes.name: A Camp without a Trace II
nodes.effect: A Camp without a Trace adds 1/3/4 progress to concealment and spring searches.

nodes.name: A Camp without a Trace III
nodes.effect: A Camp without a Trace’s ordinary shelter accommodates six people, and concealment attempts take 15 minutes instead of 30.

nodes.name: Shelter against the Siege
nodes.effect: Main Action · 1 hour, with tools and enough sound structural and concealment materials. Build a concealed fortified shelter for up to eight people on stable ground. No roll. Occupants behind its walls gain 2 Boons on defense against attacks from outside; each door or wall section has 15 HP and physical resistance 2. Open doors provide no protection. The shelter does not automatically make overnight rest safe; ordinary object damage rules apply.

nodes.name: Medicine
nodes.effect: Recognize hurt, and work patiently to ease it.

nodes.name: Field Dressing I
nodes.effect: Main Action, with a free hand and bandaging: reduce an adjacent patient’s Bleeding by 2, minimum 0, without HP restoration or a first-aid attempt. Alternatively spend 10 minutes and roll Knowledge to restore 3/5/7 HP to a patient within reach, consuming its first-aid attempt.

nodes.name: Field Dressing II
nodes.effect: Field Dressing’s first aid restores 4/6/8 HP; its immediate bandaging reduces Bleeding by 3.

nodes.name: Field Dressing III
nodes.effect: Field Dressing’s first aid takes 5 minutes. Its bandaging can be performed as a Maneuver.

nodes.name: Emergency Treatment I
nodes.effect: Main Action · Knowledge, with medical supplies. Apply Field Dressing’s current healing immediately to an adjacent patient and mark its first-aid attempt used.

nodes.name: Emergency Treatment II
nodes.effect: Emergency Treatment restores 5/7/9 HP instead of Field Dressing’s amount.

nodes.name: Emergency Treatment III
nodes.effect: Emergency Treatment also reduces Bleeding by 2, and you may move 1 square toward the patient before treating it without movement reactions.

nodes.name: A Way through Death
nodes.effect: Main Action · Knowledge, with medical supplies. Move up to 3 squares to a patient no larger than you, restore 5/8/11 HP using its available first-aid attempt, then carry it up to 3 squares and place it in a legal adjacent square. Both movements ignore movement reactions. You may rescue a patient whose allowance is spent without healing or consuming supplies. A free hand is needed to carry it; no armor training is required.

nodes.name: Patient Care I
nodes.effect: Maneuver. With suitable water, blankets or other supplies and a free hand, reduce temporary Burning or Freezing on one adjacent patient by 2, minimum 0. No roll, HP restoration or first-aid attempt.

nodes.name: Patient Care II
nodes.effect: Patient Care reduces the chosen condition by 3.

nodes.name: Patient Care III
nodes.effect: Patient Care treats two adjacent patients with supplies for both.

nodes.name: Ready the Remedy I
nodes.effect: Maneuver. Administer one prepared medical remedy you carry to an adjacent patient, using its printed effect. It must be a remedy ordinarily administered as a Main Action, not a spell, ritual or healing potion. Alternatively apply Patient Care and give that patient 1 Boon on its next Fortitude roll against an existing nonmagical disease before your next turn ends. No additional roll.

nodes.name: Ready the Remedy II
nodes.effect: After Ready the Remedy administers a prepared dose, also reduce the patient’s temporary Bleeding by 1 with suitable bandaging.

nodes.name: Ready the Remedy III
nodes.effect: Ready the Remedy can administer two prepared doses to two different adjacent patients in the same Maneuver, consuming each dose. Each may also receive its bleeding care.

nodes.name: Watch through the Night
nodes.effect: During a safe overnight rest, spend your two quiet hours tending up to four willing patients with suitable supplies. Each gains 2 Boons on its next Fortitude roll against an existing nonmagical disease before its next safe overnight rest, and reduces temporary Poisoned by 2 at the end of this care. Each patient benefits once per rest. Normal sleep, healing and recovery requirements remain; this is not an additional rest.

nodes.name: Keep Them Breathing I
nodes.effect: Reaction. Before an adjacent living creature rolls a death roll, support its breathing with a free hand and grant that roll 1 Boon. Apply its result normally. No extra roll or healing.

nodes.name: Keep Them Breathing II
nodes.effect: Keep Them Breathing grants 2 Boons.

nodes.name: Keep Them Breathing III
nodes.effect: Before Keep Them Breathing, move 1 square to reach the patient without movement reactions.

nodes.name: Hold the Moment I
nodes.effect: Reaction. When a living patient within 2 squares is about to make a death roll, move up to 2 squares to reach it without movement reactions and use a free hand to grant that roll 2 Boons. After the roll, reduce its Bleeding by 2 with suitable bandaging. This spends one Reaction and does not grant another death roll.

nodes.name: Hold the Moment II
nodes.effect: Hold the Moment can reach a patient within 3 squares by moving up to 3 squares.

nodes.name: Hold the Moment III
nodes.effect: Hold the Moment also reduces temporary Burning or Freezing by 2 after the death roll if you have appropriate water or insulating supplies.

nodes.name: One More Chance
nodes.effect: Reaction · Knowledge. Once per safe overnight rest, when an adjacent living creature would receive its third death-failure mark, use a free hand and medical supplies before death resolves. Roll: on Weak it gains the mark normally; on Standard it remains Dying at two failure marks without adding the triggering mark; on Strong stabilize it at 0 HP, clearing both death tallies as normal. This provides no HP or Grit and cannot affect an already dead creature. A patient can benefit from this named intervention only once between its safe overnight rests, regardless of healer.

nodes.name: Read the Symptoms I
nodes.effect: Main Action · 10 minutes · Knowledge. Examine a patient with observable symptoms or a sample; add 1/2/3 progress toward identifying a nonmagical disease or toxin and a plausible remedy.

nodes.name: Read the Symptoms II
nodes.effect: Read the Symptoms adds 1/3/4 progress.

nodes.name: Read the Symptoms III
nodes.effect: Read the Symptoms takes 5 minutes per attempt.

nodes.name: Prepare the Remedy I
nodes.effect: Main Action · 1 hour · Knowledge, with ingredients appropriate to a diagnosed toxin. Prepare one dose by adding 1/2/3 progress to the DA’s preparation objective. Administer the completed dose as a Main Action to reduce that toxin’s Poisoned by 2. Consume it on use. Other disease effects require their stated remedy.

nodes.name: Prepare the Remedy II
nodes.effect: Prepare the Remedy adds 1/3/4 progress.

nodes.name: Prepare the Remedy III
nodes.effect: Prepare the Remedy’s dose reduces its toxin’s Poisoned by 3 instead of 2.

nodes.name: The Field Hospital
nodes.effect: Main Action · 30 minutes, with medical supplies and a safe prepared shelter. Treat up to six patients, using each available first-aid attempt. Roll Knowledge once; each restores 5/8/11 HP and reduces temporary Bleeding or Poisoned by 2, choosing separately per patient. A patient with a spent allowance receives condition care only. Supplies must cover all patients. This creates no extra first-aid allowance, SP recovery or overnight rest.

nodes.name: Craft
nodes.effect: See the useful thing waiting inside the material.

nodes.name: Mend and Fit I
nodes.effect: Main Action, with tools and a suitable brace or fastening: temporarily secure one damaged nonmagical item within reach so it can support its ordinary stationary load until your next turn ends. It gains no HP and cannot attack or protect from attacks while broken. Alternatively work for 10 minutes and roll Knowledge for 1/2/3 progress toward repairing an item that retains enough structure.

nodes.name: Mend and Fit II
nodes.effect: Mend and Fit’s repair work adds 1/3/4 progress. Its temporary brace lasts 1 minute unless the item moves or receives further damage.

nodes.name: Mend and Fit III
nodes.effect: Mend and Fit’s repair work takes 5 minutes per attempt.

nodes.name: Field Repair I
nodes.effect: Main Action · Knowledge, with tools and materials. Work on a damaged nonmagical item within reach whose essential structure remains. Add 1/2/3 progress toward repairing it. Completion restores its ordinary function; HP restoration for an object with HP is set as part of the repair objective before work.

nodes.name: Field Repair II
nodes.effect: Field Repair adds 1/3/4 progress.

nodes.name: Field Repair III
nodes.effect: Field Repair gains 1 Boon when you can reach and work on all damaged components.

nodes.name: Make It Whole
nodes.effect: Main Action · Knowledge, with tools and matching replacement parts. Add 3/5/7 progress toward repairing one examined nonmagical mechanism or object within reach, including a shattered item whose essential pieces or replacements are available. The DA fixes the complete repair objective and restored HP before work. Completing it restores normal function, not magical properties or expended ammunition. Large structures still require access to every affected section.

nodes.name: Smoke in a Bottle I
nodes.effect: Main Action · 1 hour · Knowledge, with alchemical tools and one purchased batch of smoke ingredients. Add 1/2/3 progress toward target 3 to prepare one smoke flask. Maneuver: throw a prepared flask to a visible point within 4 squares, consuming it. Smoke fills a 1-square-radius area until your next turn ends and blocks sight through it. No throwing roll.

nodes.name: Smoke in a Bottle II
nodes.effect: Smoke in a Bottle flasks have throwing range 6 squares.

nodes.name: Smoke in a Bottle III
nodes.effect: Smoke in a Bottle flasks last until the end of your second turn after throwing.

nodes.name: Screen the Retreat I
nodes.effect: Maneuver. Throw two prepared Smoke in a Bottle flasks at separate visible points within their range. Consume both and resolve each normally.

nodes.name: Screen the Retreat II
nodes.effect: Screen the Retreat may place its two flasks within 8 squares.

nodes.name: Screen the Retreat III
nodes.effect: After Screen the Retreat, you and one willing adjacent ally may each move 1 square without movement reactions from creatures whose sight of you is blocked by the smoke.

nodes.name: Screen the Company
nodes.effect: Maneuver. Throw up to three prepared smoke flasks at visible points within 8 squares, consuming each. Each cloud fills a 2-square radius until the end of your second turn after throwing. You and up to three willing allies within 3 squares may each move 2 squares afterward; creatures whose sight of a traveler is blocked by these clouds cannot make movement reactions against that movement. Smoke blocks allies’ sight as well. No roll.

nodes.name: Catch the Failure I
nodes.effect: Reaction. When a visible component within reach begins to fail during a nonmagical task, use tools in hand to arrest it before the consequence resolves. Give the worker 1 Boon on the associated roll to prevent injury or material loss, if such a roll is possible. Once per distinct failure event; this does not improve the task’s progress roll or reverse damage already applied.

nodes.name: Catch the Failure II
nodes.effect: Catch the Failure grants 2 Boons.

nodes.name: Catch the Failure III
nodes.effect: Before Catch the Failure you may move 1 square along a safe route without movement reactions to reach the component.

nodes.name: Save the Work I
nodes.effect: Reaction. When a visible component fails during a nonmagical project within reach, use a free hand and suitable tools to preserve one recoverable component or batch of ingredients from that failure. It grants no progress and does not prevent other consequences. Once per project between safe overnight rests; the DA identifies what can physically be caught or secured.

nodes.name: Save the Work II
nodes.effect: Save the Work may preserve two recoverable components or batches from the same failure.

nodes.name: Save the Work III
nodes.effect: Save the Work also grants the worker 2 Boons on its permitted roll against injury from that event, before that roll.

nodes.name: Prevent Catastrophe
nodes.effect: Reaction. Once per scene, when an observed nonmagical structure or mechanism within reach begins to collapse, jam or burst, use tools and a suitable support to hold it for one round before its failure resolves. It must be no larger than a doorway, wagon or 2-square section of a larger structure. Creatures have time to escape or repair it; unresolved failure occurs at the end of your next turn. Attacks, magic and continued damage resolve normally and can destroy the support sooner. No roll; the support must physically bear the load.

nodes.name: Trail Workshop I
nodes.effect: Passive. Learn two recipes from Bound Torches, Fletched Ammunition, Travel Food, Twisted Cord and Wooden Brace. With tools and ingredients, work at the recipe’s interval and roll Knowledge for 1/2/3 progress or inventory steps; its output cap applies. You may also build a brace, barricade or shelter with structural materials: 1 hour and Knowledge for 1/2/3 progress toward the DA’s construction objective.

nodes.name: Trail Workshop II
nodes.effect: Trail Workshop teaches two more recipes from its list. Its construction work adds 1/3/4 progress.

nodes.name: Trail Workshop III
nodes.effect: Trail Workshop adds 1/3/4 progress or inventory steps to its recipes, respecting output caps; construction attempts take 30 minutes.

nodes.name: A Roof before Nightfall I
nodes.effect: Main Action · 1 hour, with tools and sound materials on stable ground. Build a weatherproof shelter for six people without a roll. It resists ordinary weather, not attacks or extreme hazards. You can also improvise a simple hook, wedge, lever or similar tool from suitable salvage: 10 minutes and Knowledge for 1/2/3 progress toward target 3. It lasts one task and cannot be a weapon, armor, consumable ingredient or valuable.

nodes.name: A Roof before Nightfall II
nodes.effect: A Roof before Nightfall accommodates eight people. Its improvised-tool work adds 1/3/4 progress.

nodes.name: A Roof before Nightfall III
nodes.effect: A Roof before Nightfall takes 30 minutes with materials already gathered, and you gain 1 Boon on subsequent repair rolls for that shelter.

nodes.name: A City Opens Its Gates
nodes.effect: Main Action · 1 day · Reason. Present a feasible civic project to representatives of up to four willing factions you can communicate with. Show how it would work with a plan, model or demonstration. Roll once; add 4/7/10 progress to each faction’s separate agreement objective. Completion secures the commitments established by the DA, such as access, labor or a ceasefire. New terms need a new objective; this creates neither resources nor control over a settlement.

nodes.name: Scholarship
nodes.effect: Ask the question that turns an old fact into a useful one.

nodes.name: Read the Evidence I
nodes.effect: Main Action · Reason. Examine one accessible clue within reach; add 1/2/3 progress toward a concrete question about it. Searching a scene instead takes 10 minutes per attempt. You may also recall a relevant fact about a subject or reliable description: 1 minute, Knowledge, 1/2/3 progress toward a question set before rolling.

nodes.name: Read the Evidence II
nodes.effect: Read the Evidence adds 1/3/4 progress to examination, scene searches and recall.

nodes.name: Read the Evidence III
nodes.effect: Read the Evidence takes 5 minutes per scene-search attempt; recalling a fact takes a Main Action.

nodes.name: Reconstruct the Scene I
nodes.effect: Main Action · Reason to compare up to three accessible clues, or 10 minutes to reconstruct a larger scene you can examine. Add 1/2/3 progress toward the order of up to three related events. On completion the DA states supported conclusions and gaps; this reveals no unseen thoughts.

nodes.name: Reconstruct the Scene II
nodes.effect: Reconstruct the Scene adds 1/3/4 progress.

nodes.name: Reconstruct the Scene III
nodes.effect: Reconstruct the Scene may connect up to five related events, with 1 Boon when at least two independent sources corroborate the sequence.

nodes.name: The Truth before the Council
nodes.effect: Main Action · 10 minutes · Reason. Present your findings and their supporting evidence to up to four decision-makers who understand you. Use testimony, records, exhibits or an explanation of what you found. Roll once; add 3/5/7 progress to each relevant acceptance objective. On completion a listener acknowledges the supported facts and grants the attainable concession established with the DA. Unsupported claims and inaccessible facts remain unproven.

nodes.name: Survey the Ground I
nodes.effect: Maneuver · Reason. Study one visible approach within 6 squares; add 1/2/3 progress toward identifying its usable footing and visible hazards. Surveying a whole site takes 10 minutes per attempt instead. Concealed threats require evidence to discover.

nodes.name: Survey the Ground II
nodes.effect: Survey the Ground adds 1/3/4 progress.

nodes.name: Survey the Ground III
nodes.effect: Survey the Ground also reveals one feasible fallback route when its objective completes, if one exists.

nodes.name: Prepared Retreat I
nodes.effect: Maneuver. Once per scene, direct up to three willing allies within 6 squares along a visible or familiar fallback route. Each immediately moves 2 squares without movement reactions. They must perceive your instructions; changed or blocked routes provide no passage. No roll.

nodes.name: Prepared Retreat II
nodes.effect: Prepared Retreat may direct four allies and lets each move 3 squares.

nodes.name: Prepared Retreat III
nodes.effect: You can also spend a Maneuver to point out an opening against a visible enemy to up to three allies within 6 squares. Each ally who perceives your cue gains 1 Boon on its next attack against that enemy before your next turn ends. Once per creature per scene. This grants no extra attacks or targets.

nodes.name: Name the Decisive Weakness
nodes.effect: Maneuver. Once per creature per scene, describe an opening in a visible enemy’s stance, construction or tactics. Up to four allies within 6 squares who perceive your explanation gain 2 Boons on their next attack against it before your next turn ends; each such attack ignores 1 point of one matching resistance. Immunity remains. Use this benefit in place of Prepared Retreat’s attack Boon for that creature.

nodes.name: Counterexample I
nodes.effect: Reaction. Before a listener within 6 squares rolls to assess a claim, ask a question or talk through the claim with them. If the listener understands you, give that roll 1 Boon. Once per distinct claim. No roll of your own.

nodes.name: Counterexample II
nodes.effect: Counterexample grants 2 Boons.

nodes.name: Counterexample III
nodes.effect: Counterexample may aid two listeners assessing the same claim, before their rolls. Reaction: before an ally within 6 squares rolls defense against an attack you can perceive, point out the danger. If the ally understands you, give that defense 1 Boon. Once per attacker per scene.

nodes.name: Correct the Record I
nodes.effect: Reaction · Knowledge. When a listener within 6 squares is about to act on a factual error, explain what it has missed before it acts. Add 1/2/3 progress to the DA’s objective for accepting your correction. On completion the listener understands the error and decides how to act. Once per claim per conversation. The listener must be able to understand you.

nodes.name: Correct the Record II
nodes.effect: Correct the Record adds 1/3/4 progress.

nodes.name: Correct the Record III
nodes.effect: Correct the Record may address up to three listeners with separate acceptance objectives, using one roll.

nodes.name: Proof against Panic
nodes.effect: Reaction · Knowledge. When a group within 6 squares is about to act on an alarming claim or misunderstanding, offer a credible correction it can understand before it acts. Roll once; add 3/5/7 progress to up to four listeners’ separate correction objectives. A listener whose objective completes also reduces Frightened arising from that mistaken belief by 2. Once per distinct claim per scene; true danger, magical compulsion and player decisions are unaffected.

nodes.name: Patient Translation I
nodes.effect: Main Action · 10 minutes · Knowledge, with a glossary or parallel text. Add 1/2/3 progress toward translating one short passage in an unfamiliar nonmagical language. A reference is required; ciphers need a separate objective.

nodes.name: Patient Translation II
nodes.effect: Patient Translation adds 1/3/4 progress.

nodes.name: Patient Translation III
nodes.effect: Patient Translation takes 5 minutes per attempt.

nodes.name: Bridge of Words I
nodes.effect: Main Action · 10 minutes with a willing speaker and usable shared signs or reference text. Establish simple communication about directions, quantities and immediate needs for this conversation, without a roll. Abstract bargains and hidden meanings still require translation.

nodes.name: Bridge of Words II
nodes.effect: Bridge of Words takes 5 minutes and can include up to three willing speakers who share the unfamiliar language.

nodes.name: Bridge of Words III
nodes.effect: Once Bridge of Words is established, gain 1 Boon on translation rolls using notes or examples gathered from that conversation.

nodes.name: The Lost Lexicon
nodes.effect: Main Action · 1 hour · Knowledge, with at least three substantial texts or a text and a willing fluent speaker. Add 3/5/7 progress toward reconstructing an unfamiliar nonmagical writing system. On completion create a working glossary that serves as a reference for Patient Translation for anyone who can read your notes. Missing vocabulary, ciphers and magical meanings remain separate questions; the glossary does not grant fluent speech.

nodes.name: Influence
nodes.effect: Open a door, steady a friend or turn a room.

nodes.name: Make the Case I
nodes.effect: Main Action · Reason for a brief appeal, or one exchange for a longer discussion. Present a credible argument or offer to someone who understands you; add 1/2/3 progress toward the social objective established by the DA.

nodes.name: Make the Case II
nodes.effect: Make the Case adds 1/3/4 progress.

nodes.name: Make the Case III
nodes.effect: Once per objective, add 1 extra progress to Make the Case when you answer a listener’s concern with a new fact, concrete offer or demonstration.

nodes.name: Common Ground I
nodes.effect: Main Action · Reason for a brief proposal, or one exchange for detailed terms. Propose common terms to two willing negotiating sides who understand you. Roll once; add 1/2/3 progress to each side’s separate acceptance objective. Each side retains its established boundaries.

nodes.name: Common Ground II
nodes.effect: Common Ground adds 1/3/4 progress to each objective.

nodes.name: Common Ground III
nodes.effect: Common Ground can address three willing negotiating sides with separate objectives.

nodes.name: A Treaty in Common Words
nodes.effect: Main Action · 30 minutes · Reason. With willing representatives of up to three sides and a working language, interpreter or shared reference text, formulate one concrete agreement. Roll once; add 3/5/7 progress to each side’s acceptance objective. On completion the DA states that side’s commitments and known reservations plainly. A shared reference permits simple terms; complex terms need adequate translation. No side accepts impossible terms, and the agreement is not magical enforcement.

nodes.name: Steady Voice I
nodes.effect: Maneuver. One willing ally within 4 squares who hears and understands your reassurance reduces Frightened by 1. No roll.

nodes.name: Steady Voice II
nodes.effect: Steady Voice reduces Frightened by 2.

nodes.name: Steady Voice III
nodes.effect: Steady Voice affects two willing allies within range.

nodes.name: Rally the Line I
nodes.effect: Maneuver. Up to three willing allies within 6 squares who perceive and understand your signal reduce Frightened by 2. One of them may also move 1 square toward you without movement reactions. No roll.

nodes.name: Rally the Line II
nodes.effect: Rally the Line can affect four allies.

nodes.name: Rally the Line III
nodes.effect: Each ally affected by Rally the Line may move 1 square toward you without movement reactions.

nodes.name: Hold the Company Together
nodes.effect: Maneuver. Once per scene, up to four willing allies within 6 squares who perceive and understand you reduce Frightened and Dazed by 2 each, gain 1 Boon on their next defense before your next turn starts, and may move 2 squares toward you without movement reactions. This grants no additional actions or Reactions. No roll.

nodes.name: Plausible Rejoinder I
nodes.effect: Reaction · Guile. When a listener who understands you challenges your account or questions your distraction, answer before its response resolves; add 1/2/3 progress toward the DA’s deception objective. Once per distinct challenge per exchange. You may also present an ordinary plausible false account during an exchange using the same progress; repetition and impossible claims earn no progress.

nodes.name: Plausible Rejoinder II
nodes.effect: Plausible Rejoinder adds 1/3/4 progress.

nodes.name: Plausible Rejoinder III
nodes.effect: Once per objective, add 1 extra progress to Plausible Rejoinder when you give the listener a new reason to believe the account, such as a telling detail, prop or supporting witness.

nodes.name: Hold Their Attention I
nodes.effect: Reaction · Guile. When up to three listeners within 6 squares who understand you begin to turn attention from your ongoing plausible distraction, renew it with a new detail before they act. Add 1/2/3 progress toward holding their attention for one minute. On completion allies gain 1 Boon on unnoticed tasks outside those listeners’ direct sight for that minute. Once per distinct interruption; you may also begin this distraction through an ordinary exchange.

nodes.name: Hold Their Attention II
nodes.effect: Hold Their Attention adds 1/3/4 progress.

nodes.name: Hold Their Attention III
nodes.effect: Hold Their Attention can engage five listeners; an immediate obvious danger ends its distraction.

nodes.name: Turn the Conversation
nodes.effect: Reaction · Guile. Once per conversation, when listeners are about to dismiss your distraction or false account, offer a credible alternative explanation before they act. Roll once; add 3/5/7 progress to up to four listeners’ separate objectives for accepting it. Each completed objective keeps that listener engaged for one minute, giving allies 2 Boons on unnoticed tasks outside its sight during that time. Contradictory proof and impossible explanations cannot be talked away; direct danger ends the distraction.

nodes.name: Draw the Line I
nodes.effect: Main Action · One exchange · Brawn. State a credible immediate consequence you can carry out to a listener who perceives and understands the threat; add 1/2/3 progress toward a limited concession established by the DA.

nodes.name: Draw the Line II
nodes.effect: Draw the Line adds 1/3/4 progress.

nodes.name: Draw the Line III
nodes.effect: Once per objective, add 1 extra progress to Draw the Line when you show or explain how you could carry out the consequence without attacking the listener.

nodes.name: Terms of Surrender I
nodes.effect: Main Action · Reason. Offer a feasible surrender to up to three enemies who understand you. Roll once; add 1/2/3 progress to their shared objective if they share a motive, otherwise to one chosen enemy’s objective. They continue acting until an objective completes.

nodes.name: Terms of Surrender II
nodes.effect: Terms of Surrender adds 1/3/4 progress.

nodes.name: Terms of Surrender III
nodes.effect: Terms of Surrender can address six enemies with a shared motive; otherwise choose one as before.

nodes.name: A Way to Yield
nodes.effect: Main Action · Reason. Once per scene, offer a credible, immediately available path out of a conflict to up to six enemies who understand you: surrender under stated protection, withdraw through an open route, or release captives for safe passage. Roll once; add 3/5/7 progress to their shared objective if their motives align, otherwise one chosen enemy’s objective. On completion they accept the established concession while you honor its terms. This grants no automatic ceasefire before completion and no control over independent allies.

nodes.name: Elements
nodes.effect: Shape the physical world: heat, water, stone and air.

nodes.name: Life
nodes.effect: Restore, transform, cultivate and unravel living things.

nodes.name: Mentalism
nodes.effect: Thought, feeling, perception and the dreaming mind.

nodes.name: Divination
nodes.effect: Find what is hidden across distance, history and possibility.

nodes.name: Invocation
nodes.effect: Contact beings, establish bonds and cross boundaries.

nodes.name: Force
nodes.effect: Move, shape, animate and enchant the material world.

nodes.name: Wards
nodes.effect: Protect people and places; secure and unravel magic.

nodes.name: Spellcraft
nodes.effect: Study your reserves, restore your focus and channel magical power.

nodes.name: Soul Capacity I
nodes.effect: Passive. Increase maximum SP by 2.

nodes.name: Soul Capacity II
nodes.effect: Increase maximum SP by another 2; this path now grants +4 maximum SP.

nodes.name: Soul Capacity III
nodes.effect: Increase maximum SP by another 3; this path now grants +7 maximum SP.

nodes.name: Deep Reserves I
nodes.effect: Passive. Increase maximum SP by another 3; this path now grants +10 maximum SP.

nodes.name: Deep Reserves II
nodes.effect: Increase maximum SP by another 3; this path now grants +13 maximum SP.

nodes.name: Deep Reserves III
nodes.effect: Increase maximum SP by another 3; this path now grants +16 maximum SP.

nodes.name: Soul Wellspring
nodes.effect: Passive. Increase maximum SP by another 4; this path now grants +20 maximum SP. Once between safe overnight rests, when you spend SP to cast a spell, you may pay up to 2 of its SP from this reserve without reducing current SP. Declare the amount before casting; any unused part of that one payment is lost, not saved for another spell. This grants no additional casting or current-SP recovery.

nodes.name: Mind Capacity I
nodes.effect: Passive. Increase maximum SP by 2.

nodes.name: Mind Capacity II
nodes.effect: Increase maximum SP by another 2; this path now grants +4 maximum SP.

nodes.name: Mind Capacity III
nodes.effect: Increase maximum SP by another 3; this path now grants +7 maximum SP.

nodes.name: Ordered Mind I
nodes.effect: Passive. Increase maximum SP by another 3; this path now grants +10 maximum SP.

nodes.name: Ordered Mind II
nodes.effect: Increase maximum SP by another 3; this path now grants +13 maximum SP.

nodes.name: Ordered Mind III
nodes.effect: Increase maximum SP by another 3; this path now grants +16 maximum SP.

nodes.name: Mind Palace
nodes.effect: Passive. Increase maximum SP by another 4; this path now grants +20 maximum SP. Once between safe overnight rests, when you begin a ritual you have learned, reduce its total printed SP cost by 2, minimum 0. For a ritual with daily payments, reduce only its first payment. Declare before beginning; interruption still spends that benefit. Work time, materials and other requirements remain.

nodes.name: Recovery I
nodes.effect: 1 uninterrupted hour of safe rest, meditation or quiet leisure. Once between safe overnight rests, recover 1 SP. You can spend this hour during a Brief Rest and add this SP to what the rest restores.

nodes.name: Recovery II
nodes.effect: The same single recovery rest restores 2 SP in total.

nodes.name: Recovery III
nodes.effect: The same single recovery rest restores 3 SP in total.

nodes.name: Quiet Renewal I
nodes.effect: The same single recovery rest restores 4 SP in total. Learning this step does not grant another use if that rest has already been used.

nodes.name: Quiet Renewal II
nodes.effect: The same single recovery rest restores 6 SP in total.

nodes.name: Quiet Renewal III
nodes.effect: The same single recovery rest restores 8 SP in total.

nodes.name: Perfect Repose
nodes.effect: The same single recovery rest restores 12 SP in total and takes 30 uninterrupted minutes of safe rest or quiet leisure instead of an hour. It remains once between safe overnight rests and does not count as a safe overnight rest. No Grit, first-aid allowance or other limited use is refreshed.

books.name: Ormund’s Codex of Stone & Deep Places
Serevan’s Book of Restoration
books.theme: Repair the body without bypassing recovery limits.

books.name: Ilyra’s Book of Thought
books.theme: Communication and bounded access to thought.

books.name: Ilyra’s Book of Emotion
