spells.effect: A narrow beam deals 6/9/12 force damage. An unattended nonmagical object of Bulk 3 or less is reduced to dust if this damage destroys it. Living targets follow normal HP and dying rules.

spells.name: Reverse Gravity
spells.target: Every creature in a 2-square-radius area within 12 squares
spells.duration: Until the end of your next turn
spells.effect: Lift each affected creature 2/4/6 squares vertically from its starting position, stopping at solid obstacles. It floats there until expiry, then falls from that height using the normal falling rules. A creature already holding a fixed support may keep its grip and remain supported. A floating creature may use ordinary movement to climb a reachable fixed surface or fly out of the affected area; leaving the area ends its levitation. This working affects the chosen creatures once, when cast.

spells.name: Mending
spells.target: One unattended mundane item of Bulk 1 or less in your hands
spells.effect: Rejoin a small clean break or tear while holding all its pieces together. Restore ordinary function to that part. For an item with HP, the DA states before casting whether this small repair is sufficient and how many HP it restores, following the repair-objective rules. Missing components and substantial reconstruction use repair projects.

spells.name: Grease
spells.target: Four connected ground squares within 6 squares
spells.effect: Coat the ground in slippery magical grease. It becomes difficult terrain. A creature entering from outside may move carefully for 2 additional movement, or become Prone after moving into its first greasy square. Choose when entering.

spells.name: Enlarge/Reduce — Objects
spells.target: One unattended nonmagical object of Bulk 2 or less within 6 squares
spells.effect: Double or halve its dimensions and Bulk, rounding Bulk up with a minimum of 1. Its material and function remain ordinary. It returns to original size at expiry; allow enough space for either size when casting.

spells.name: Unlocking Ways
spells.target: One adjacent mundane lock
spells.effect: Guide its mechanism with invisible tools. Add 1/2/3 progress toward the lock's DA-set opening objective. The spell supplies delicate manipulation; an explicit magical seal uses its named remedy.

spells.name: Heat Metal — Forge
spells.target: One unattended metal workpiece of Bulk 3 or less within reach
spells.effect: Heat it evenly to forging temperature or cool it to a safe working temperature. Use suitable tools to shape it with ordinary Craft procedures. The workpiece cools naturally when the duration ends.

spells.name: Stone Shape — Craft
spells.target: One adjacent unattended stone mass up to one square in each dimension
spells.effect: Shape a simple brace, slab, stair or other solid construction component, preserving its volume. Fine mechanisms and final fitting use ordinary tools. Living stone creatures follow creature-targeting spells.

spells.name: Fabricate
spells.target: Prepared ordinary materials and tools beside you
spells.effect: Work the materials toward one mundane item or component of Bulk 6 or less whose construction you understand. Each completed ritual adds 3/5/7 progress toward its ordinary crafting objective, using the normal recipe and material quantities. The item is ready when that objective is complete. Finish fine details with the required tools.

spells.name: Earthen Transmutations
spells.target: One adjacent unattended square of earth or stone, up to 1 square deep
spells.effect: Turn loose earth into ordinary stone or ordinary stone into compacted earth. Preserve the material's volume. The DA identifies unsupported structures before casting; changing their support uses the normal collapse procedure.

spells.name: Passwall — Workshop
spells.target: One adjacent ordinary wall up to 2 squares thick
spells.effect: Make a work opening 1 square wide and 2 high through stone or earth. At expiry the opening closes; occupants emerge at the nearest end first. Secure ordinary supports before using it in a load-bearing wall.

spells.name: Meld Wall
spells.target: Two adjacent ordinary stone surfaces, each up to 4 squares in area
spells.effect: Join them into one sound wall or floor, or separate them along one clean seam. Supply adequate support and matching stone. The resulting structure has the strength and vulnerabilities of ordinary masonry.

spells.name: True Polymorph — Objects
spells.target: One unattended nonmagical object of Bulk 12 or less; 100 coins of reagents consumed
spells.effect: Reshape it into one mundane object of equal or smaller Bulk made of stone, wood, glass or common iron. Choose an ordinary function whose construction you understand, with all necessary parts. It has that material’s ordinary qualities and provides no precious substances or learned abilities. Keep one such transformation at a time; dismissing it, completing another, or unraveling it returns the surviving material to its original form. Separated pieces remain parts of the same transformation, not new objects to copy.

spells.name: Prestidigitation
spells.target: One unattended object or 1-square space within 6 squares
spells.effect: Clean or soil a hand-sized surface, change a small object's harmless scent or color, or create a tiny visual spark. Choose one effect when casting; its physical scale remains hand-sized.

spells.name: Unseen Servant — Workshop
spells.target: One open square within 3 squares
spells.effect: Create a Clay Helper energy form from Summoned Companions. Give its immediate Main command. Use its printed abilities, normal commands and six-square tether for workshop chores; provide real tools and materials.

spells.name: Enchanted Rope — Rigging
spells.target: One unattended rope up to 12 squares long within 6 squares
spells.effect: Teach the rope a sequence of up to three knots or anchors in reachable open space. Spend a Maneuver to advance one step. It supports ordinary rope loads after securing itself and retains its normal strength.

spells.name: Dancing Weapon
spells.target: One unattended melee weapon within 3 squares; attack within 6 squares
spells.effect: Set the weapon dancing as a single summoned form with 6 HP, Speed 4 and your attributes for defenses. Give one immediate Main command to attack for 2/4/6 physical damage or perform an ordinary manipulation. Further activity uses normal commands and the six-square tether; it has no independent Reaction.

spells.name: Animate Objects
spells.target: Up to three unattended objects, combined Bulk at most 3, within 6 squares
spells.effect: Animate them as one group with shared 10 HP, Speed 4, and your attributes for defenses. They occupy one square together. Give one immediate Main command to attack one adjacent target for 3/5/7 physical damage or perform a simple task. Use normal commands and the six-square tether thereafter.

spells.name: Low Intelligence
spells.target: One prepared object beside you; 50 coins of reagents consumed
spells.effect: Awaken a mind with Knowledge +1 and memory of three short instructions. Within 6 squares, you communicate telepathically and may use its score for Knowledge rolls, including casting, under the fixed-value item rules. Your own attributes determine DP, class qualifications and maximum SP. Keep one intelligent item of any grade. Movement and work use separate animation and commands.

spells.name: Medium Intelligence
spells.target: One prepared object beside you; 100 coins of reagents consumed
spells.effect: Awaken a mind with Knowledge +2 and one language you know. It remembers ten short messages and hears within 1 square. Within 6 squares, you communicate telepathically and may use its score for Knowledge rolls, including casting, under the fixed-value item rules. Your own attributes determine DP, class qualifications and maximum SP. This replaces your prior intelligent item; physical activity uses separate animation and commands.

spells.name: High Intelligence
spells.target: One prepared object beside you; 150 coins of reagents consumed
spells.effect: Awaken a mind with Knowledge +3, one language you know and a chosen personality. It hears within 3 squares and remembers its week's experiences. Within 6 squares, you communicate telepathically and may use its score for Knowledge rolls, including casting, under the fixed-value item rules. Your own attributes determine DP, class qualifications and maximum SP. This replaces your prior intelligent item; physical activity uses separate animation and commands.

spells.name: Very High Intelligence
spells.target: One prepared object beside you; 250 coins of reagents consumed
spells.effect: Awaken a mind with Knowledge +4, two languages you know and a chosen personality. It sees and hears within 3 squares and remembers its experiences. Within 6 squares, you communicate telepathically and may use its score for Knowledge rolls, including casting, under the fixed-value item rules. Your own attributes determine DP, class qualifications and maximum SP. This replaces your prior intelligent item; physical activity uses separate animation and commands.

spells.name: Animate Objects — Greater
spells.target: Up to six unattended objects, combined Bulk at most 6, within 6 squares
spells.effect: Animate one group occupying a 2-by-2-square space, with shared 18 HP, Speed 4 and your attributes for defenses. Give one immediate Main command. A Main command can attack up to two adjacent targets for 3/5/7 physical damage each, rolling once, or perform one larger ordinary task. Normal commands and six-square tether apply.

spells.name: Simulacrum
spells.target: One willing adjacent living model; 300 coins of sculpting materials consumed
spells.effect: Sculpt the model’s appearance and voice into a likeness with 10 HP, 0 SP, 0 Grit, your Speed and defense attributes. Give one immediate Main command. Thereafter, a normal Main command directs an ordinary task or Basic Melee attack: Knowledge, 2/3/5 physical damage. Unlike other summons, it remains inert when uncommanded, beyond the six-square tether, or while you are unconscious or dead. It responds only to your commands while you are conscious and within that range. It has no Reactions, spells, learned abilities or healing. At 0 HP or when you create another, it disappears without harming the model.

spells.name: Light
spells.target: One unattended object or object held by a willing creature within 6 squares
spells.effect: Make it shed bright light to 6 squares and dim light for another 3. Choose the color. You may keep one Light casting at a time and end it with a Maneuver.

spells.name: Magic Weapon
spells.target: One held weapon belonging to a willing creature within 6 squares
spells.effect: Give the weapon's damaging attacks +1 physical damage before resistance. Apply this once per target per attack. Use the highest magical weapon damage increase.

spells.name: Elemental Weapon
spells.target: One held weapon belonging to a willing creature within 6 squares
spells.effect: Choose fire, cold or lightning. Its attacks deal that type in place of their normal damage type and add 1 damage before resistance. Use the highest magical weapon damage increase; each attack remains one damage event per target.

spells.name: Rune Mastery
spells.target: One held rune-stone and one known Main Action spell costing at most 2 SP
spells.effect: Pay the stored spell's SP in addition to this ritual. Inscribe its power into the stone. A bearer uses a Main Action to release it, choosing legal targets from their position and using your class’s casting attribute and your value for it. The stone holds one use; you may keep one prepared Rune Mastery stone at a time.

spells.name: Magic Mouth
spells.target: One adjacent unattended object
spells.effect: Record up to twenty-five spoken words and one visible or audible trigger within 3 squares of the object. The first matching event makes the object speak the message once, then ends the spell.

spells.name: Continual Flame
spells.target: One unattended object held throughout the ritual; 10 coins of luminous oil consumed
spells.effect: Kindle a cool magical flame that sheds bright light to 6 squares. It illuminates without consuming fuel. You may keep up to three such flames; creating a fourth ends the oldest.

spells.name: Holy Symbol
spells.target: One held holy symbol
spells.effect: Consecrate it to your chosen spiritual tradition. A bearer holding it gains 1 Boon to its first healing roll or defense against an undead creature, then the blessing ends. You may keep one consecrated symbol at a time.

spells.name: Weapon I
spells.target: One weapon beside you; 25 coins of enchanting oil consumed
spells.effect: The weapon's damaging attacks gain +1 damage of their normal type before resistance, once per target per attack. Use the highest magical weapon increase. You may keep one Weapon I enchantment at a time.

spells.name: Contingency
spells.target: Self and one known Main Action spell costing at most 2 SP
spells.effect: Pay the chosen spell's SP in addition to this ritual. Name a visible or bodily trigger and legal self-directed effect. When triggered while conscious, spend your Reaction to release that spell on yourself. You may keep one Contingency; casting another replaces the earlier preparation.

spells.name: Armor IV
spells.target: One suit of armor beside you; 100 coins of enchanting oil consumed
spells.effect: Choose fire, cold, lightning, poison, life, radiant, mental or force. While worn with its normal training, the suit grants resistance 2 to that damage type. Use the highest matching resistance. You may keep one Armor IV enchantment at a time.

spells.name: Imbue Spell
spells.target: One unattended mundane handheld item; 200 coins of enchanting materials consumed
spells.effect: Bind one known Main Action or Maneuver spell costing 1–5 SP into the item. Its bearer may release that spell once between your safe overnight rests, using the spell’s stated action and attribute, with the bearer’s attribute value and position. The release costs 0 SP; all other casting requirements, materials and costs apply. The bearer handles any Sustain or commands. Choose a spell from outside Channeling that neither restores or transfers SP nor enchants another item. You keep one imbued item. Completing another ends the previous enchantment without renewing its used release; all your replacements share that allowance. Your normal safe overnight rest renews the allowance once per 24 hours.

spells.name: Sacred Flame
spells.target: One creature within 12 squares
spells.effect: Call a descending spark of sacred light. Deal 2/3/5 radiant damage.

spells.name: Shield
spells.actionText: Reaction · before the roll for an attack your magical shield can block
spells.trigger: before the roll for an attack your magical shield can block
spells.target: Self
spells.duration: Until the start of your next turn
spells.effect: Raise a translucent shield in a free hand. Declare this Reaction before the roll for an attack the shield could block; the DA judges its coverage as for an ordinary shield. While keeping that hand available until your next turn starts, gain 1 Boon on defenses against attacks it can block. If an attacker rolls instead, apply 1 Bane to that roll. Shield and Shield Block supply the same shield benefit: use it once, while combining Defend and other modifiers normally. Ending the spell frees the hand. This Reaction casting does not provoke an opportunity attack.

spells.name: Mage Armor
spells.target: Self
spells.effect: Clothe yourself in a protective magical outline. Gain physical resistance 1, using the highest matching resistance. The armor persists for eight hours without Sustain.

spells.name: Bladeturn
spells.actionText: Reaction · after your defense against an adjacent melee attack
spells.trigger: after your defense against an adjacent melee attack
spells.target: Self
spells.effect: Turn the edge aside. Reduce its physical damage by 2 after resistance, keeping the attack's minimum 1 damage.

spells.name: Protection from Evil and Good
spells.target: One willing creature within 6 squares
spells.effect: Ward the recipient against summoned forms, undead and spirits. It gains 1 Boon to defenses against attacks and hostile spells from those creatures.

spells.name: Protection from Energy
spells.target: One willing creature within 6 squares
spells.effect: Choose fire, cold, lightning or poison. Grant resistance 2 to that type for the duration, using the highest matching resistance.

spells.name: Death Ward
spells.target: One willing creature within 6 squares
spells.effect: The first time damage would reduce the recipient from positive HP to 0, leave it at 1 HP and end the ward. A creature can benefit from Death Ward once between safe overnight rests. Record that use when it triggers.

spells.name: Warding Bond
spells.target: One willing creature within 6 squares; remain within 6 squares
spells.effect: Bind your protection to the recipient. When an attack would damage it, you may spend your Reaction after its resistance and other reductions, before it loses HP. Transfer up to 3 of that damage to yourself, leaving at least 1 on it. The transferred damage bypasses your resistance. The bond ends if either participant becomes unconscious or moves beyond 6 squares.

spells.name: Globe of Invulnerability
spells.target: Self and willing creatures within 2 squares of you
spells.effect: Raise a shimmering globe centered on you. Protected creatures gain 1 Boon to defenses against spells and resistance 2 to spell damage. Apply the highest matching resistance. The protection moves with you.

spells.name: Mind Blank
spells.target: One willing adjacent creature
spells.effect: Veil its thoughts. Grant mental resistance 3 and 2 Boons to defenses against mental spells. Reading its memories or locating it through divination requires its consent while the veil lasts. Ordinary observation and conversation remain available.

spells.name: Prismatic Wall
spells.target: Six connected unoccupied squares within 12 squares
spells.effect: Raise a luminous wall 2 squares high that blocks sight. Roll on casting to set radiant damage at 4/6/8. A creature crossing it takes that damage and Slowed 2, once per creature each round. The caster can end the wall with a Maneuver.

spells.name: Detect Magic — Threads
spells.target: One visible magical effect within 6 squares
spells.effect: See its magical threads. Learn whether it is sustained, fixed-duration or permanent, and which creature is presently sustaining it if that creature is visible.

spells.name: Counterspell
spells.actionText: Reaction · when a visible caster finishes a spell
spells.trigger: when a visible caster finishes a spell
spells.target: The spell; caster within 6 squares
spells.effect: Add 1/2/3 cancellation progress against the triggering spell. Its target is 2 plus its printed SP cost. At completion it ends before resolving. Otherwise its caster receives 1 Bane on any roll made to resolve it; the incomplete cancellation progress then expires.

spells.name: Remove Curse
spells.target: One adjacent cursed creature or object
spells.effect: Add 2/3/4 cancellation progress toward one curse's target, normally 2 plus the source spell's SP cost. Accumulate progress across attempts against that same curse. A source that explicitly names Remove Curse as an immediate remedy ends automatically instead.

spells.name: Dispel Magic
spells.target: One visible ongoing spell within 6 squares
spells.effect: Add 2/3/4 cancellation progress against the chosen effect, target 2 plus its printed SP cost. At completion, end that effect. Partial progress remains while that casting lasts.

spells.name: Cancel Essence
spells.target: One ongoing Elements or Force spell within 6 squares
spells.effect: Read and pull apart its elemental structure. Add 3/4/5 cancellation progress toward target 2 plus the spell's printed SP cost. Completing the objective ends that casting.

spells.name: Cancel Mentalism
spells.target: One ongoing Mentalism or Divination spell within 6 squares
spells.effect: Quiet its mental pattern. Add 3/4/5 cancellation progress toward target 2 plus the spell's printed SP cost. Completing the objective ends that casting.

spells.name: Cancel Channeling
spells.target: One ongoing Life, Invocation, Wards or Spellcraft spell within 6 squares
spells.effect: Sever its channel of power. Add 3/4/5 cancellation progress toward target 2 plus its printed SP cost. Completing the objective ends that casting. Independent creatures contacted by magic retain their own existence.

spells.name: Dispel True
spells.target: Up to three visible ongoing spells within 6 squares
spells.effect: Choose one shared cancellation total of 4/6/8 progress and divide it among the effects, assigning at least 1 to each. Each target is 2 plus that spell's printed SP cost. End each effect whose objective is completed.

spells.name: Antimagic Field
spells.target: A 1-square-radius area centered on you
spells.effect: Create a quiet zone where magical effects, including your own, are suspended except for this field and its upkeep. Casting and magical targeting operate outside the zone; ongoing durations continue to pass inside it. Effects resume after leaving if their durations remain. Mundane equipment and ordinary actions work normally.

spells.name: Cancel True
spells.actionText: Reaction · when a visible caster finishes a spell
spells.trigger: when a visible caster finishes a spell
spells.target: The spell; caster within 8 squares
spells.effect: Add 3/5/7 cancellation progress toward target 2 plus its printed SP cost. At completion it ends before resolving. Otherwise its caster receives 2 Banes on any resolution roll, and incomplete cancellation progress expires.

spells.name: Unessence
spells.target: One adjacent permanent enchantment; 100 coins of cleansing reagents consumed
spells.effect: Unweave one identified magical property while preserving the physical item. Add 6/9/12 progress toward target 12 for an ordinary permanent enchantment, or its own stated removal target. Keep progress against that property across attempts. At completion the property ends; other properties remain. Each attempt consumes the printed reagents. Exceptional artifacts follow their stated remedies.

spells.name: Resistance
spells.target: One willing creature within 6 squares
spells.effect: Choose fire, cold, lightning or poison. Grant resistance 1 to that type, using the highest matching resistance.

spells.name: Sanctuary
spells.target: One willing creature within 6 squares
spells.effect: Give the recipient 1 Boon to defenses while it attends to healing, movement or other peaceful actions. Its first attack or harmful spell ends the ward after that action resolves.

spells.name: Quiet Ways
spells.target: Self and up to three willing creatures within 6 squares
spells.effect: Soften footfalls and rustling gear. Recipients gain 1 Boon to sneaking that depends on quiet movement. Speech and deliberate noise remain audible.

spells.name: Tiny Hut
spells.target: A fixed 2-square-radius dome on clear ground beside you
spells.effect: Create a weatherproof shelter for six Medium creatures and their ordinary gear. It has an openable entrance and translucent walls. Ordinary rain, snow and wind stay outside; occupants can leave and return. The shelter provides cover but no resistance to attacks. Choose a safe site for overnight recovery.

spells.name: Private Sanctum
spells.target: One fixed room up to 6 by 6 squares beside you
spells.effect: Seal ordinary sound inside the room and make its windows opaque from outside. Remote magical sensors report only a blank space unless their caster completes a cancellation objective against this working. Doors remain usable by ordinary means.

spells.name: Hallow
spells.target: A fixed 4-square-radius site beside you; 50 coins of incense consumed
spells.effect: Consecrate the site. Willing occupants gain 1 Boon to defenses against undead and spirits while inside. Ordinary remains there resist decay for the duration. Choose the site's visible symbol when casting.

spells.name: Guards and Wards
spells.target: A building of up to six connected rooms beside you
spells.effect: Ward the rooms with soft warning bells. Name up to six guests. When another creature opens an exterior door or window, you hear its location while within 100 squares. It receives Slowed 1 on first entry, once per creature. Doors remain physically operable and warnings persist even after that slowing ends.

spells.name: Antilife Shell
spells.target: A 1-square-radius ring centered on you
spells.effect: A barrier of repelling force surrounds you. A living creature crossing its boundary spends 2 extra movement and becomes Slowed 1, once per round. The ring moves with you; moving it over a creature applies the same effect rather than pushing it automatically.

spells.name: Forbiddance
spells.target: A fixed 6-by-6-square site beside you; 100 coins of incense consumed
spells.effect: Seal the site against teleportation and planar passage. A travel spell entering or leaving arrives at the nearest safe boundary square instead. Ordinary movement remains available. A successful cancellation objective ends the seal.

spells.name: Magnificent Mansion
spells.target: One doorway on an adjacent solid surface
spells.effect: Open a comfortable refuge with six furnished rooms, clean water and bedding for twelve. The entrance remains fixed and visible; you may open or close it with a Maneuver while beside it. At expiry occupants and their possessions emerge into safe space beside the original entrance. Furnishings remain part of the refuge. Food is brought by the guests.

spells.name: Mighty Fortress
spells.target: One prepared 12-by-12-square site; soil, water, stone and 600 coins of materials consumed
spells.duration: Permanent structure; wards renewed for 24 hours
spells.effect: On a sound prepared site, raise a one-story living keep with six rooms, a courtyard, a gate and walls 3 squares high. Pay 10 SP on each workday. Walls block movement and sight; each 1-square section has 20 HP and physical resistance 3, and takes at least 1 damage per attack. Designate up to twelve residents. Paying 4 SP at dawn renews the wards for 24 hours: residents inside gain 1 Boon to defenses, and you sense any breached wall’s location while inside. Without renewal the ordinary structure remains. It needs food, water and repairs. You may ward one citadel at a time.

spells.name: Mage Seal
spells.target: One closed unattended container within 1 square
spells.effect: Place a visible personal mark across its opening. Opening the container visibly breaks the mark. You recognize your own seal and whether it was broken when you next inspect it.

spells.name: Alarm
spells.target: One doorway or 2-square-radius area beside you
spells.effect: Name up to six guests. When another creature crosses the boundary, a chime sounds within 6 squares or you receive a mental warning while within 100 squares; choose when casting. The first warning ends the spell.

spells.name: Arcane Lock
spells.target: One adjacent closed door or container
spells.effect: Add magical fastening. An ordinary opening objective increases by 3 progress. Name up to six creatures who may operate it normally. Knock ends the magical fastening automatically. Completing a cancellation objective also ends it. Physical locks remain in place.

spells.name: Knock
spells.target: One lock or fastening within 6 squares
spells.effect: A sharp knock carries 12 squares. Choose one fastening. Against Arcane Lock, end its magical fastening automatically and leave any physical lock in place. Against an ordinary fastening, roll to add 2/3/4 progress toward opening it.

spells.name: Magic Mouth — Warning
spells.target: One fixed object within reach
spells.effect: Record a warning of up to twenty-five words and a visible or audible trigger within 6 squares. The first matching event speaks the warning loudly enough to hear within 12 squares, then ends the spell.

spells.name: Glyph of Warding
spells.target: One fixed surface within reach; burst within 1 square of it
spells.effect: Inscribe a visible glyph and define a creature crossing or touching its surface as the trigger. On the first trigger, every creature in the burst takes 3/5/7 force damage, set by your ritual roll. The glyph triggers once. Moving its surface more than 1 square ends it safely.

spells.name: Rune Mastery — Seal
spells.target: One fixed seal and one known Main Action spell costing at most 2 SP
spells.effect: Pay the stored spell's SP in addition to the ritual. Choose its targets relative to the seal and a visible or audible trigger within 3 squares. At the first trigger, release it using your class’s casting attribute and legal targets, then end the seal. Keep one such prepared seal at a time.

spells.name: Secret Chest
spells.target: One adjacent chest holding up to 12 Bulk; 25 coins of incense consumed
spells.effect: Hide the chest and its contents in a private folded space. While beside its original location, use a Main Action to return it there. At expiry it returns automatically to the nearest open space. Living creatures remain outside; keep one Secret Chest at a time.

spells.name: Symbol
spells.target: One fixed visible inscription; targets within 2 squares
spells.effect: Choose a visible trigger and either dread or bewilderment. On its first occurrence, up to three creatures you specify by position gain Frightened 2/3/4 or Dazed 1/1/2, set by your ritual roll. Dread names the inscription as source. The inscription then fades.

spells.name: Sequester
spells.target: One willing creature or unattended object beside you; 100 coins of incense consumed
spells.effect: Place it in a concealed, motionless magical sleep or stasis. It becomes Invisible and its bodily needs pause. Touching it with the token you designate, Remove Curse, or expiry awakens and reveals it. Record its HP and SP on entry; those values return unchanged.

spells.name: Gate — World Anchor
spells.target: Two known prepared stone anchors and 1,000 coins of materials consumed
spells.duration: Permanent, until an anchor is destroyed or the pair is replaced
spells.effect: Prepare both sites with their owners’ permission and pay 10 SP on each workday. Join the anchors with a permanent paired gateway, 2 squares wide, even across planes. Create two keys. At either anchor, a keyholder may spend a Main Action and 3 of their own SP to open both ends for 10 minutes, or a Maneuver to close them. Anyone can cross an open gateway. Each anchor has 30 HP and physical resistance 3 and takes at least 1 damage per attack. Destroying either ends the connection. Keep one pair; completing another ends the first.

spells.name: Power Shock
spells.target: One creature within 6 squares
spells.effect: Strike with a pulse of raw magical pressure. Deal 2/3/5 force damage.

spells.name: Give Power
spells.target: One adjacent willing creature with its own SP reserve
spells.effect: After paying this spell's 1 SP cost, transfer up to 3 of your remaining SP to the recipient. Choose the amount up to its missing SP. Subtract every point received from your reserve.

spells.name: Draw Power
spells.target: One adjacent willing creature with its own SP reserve
spells.effect: After paying this spell's 1 SP cost, receive up to 3 SP from the donor, limited by its current reserve and your missing SP. The donor chooses the amount and loses exactly what you receive.

spells.name: Siphon Power
spells.target: One creature within 6 squares with its own SP reserve
spells.effect: Transfer 1/2/3 of the target's current SP into your reserve, limited by its available SP and your missing SP after paying the casting cost. Every point received leaves the target's reserve. An empty reserve transfers 0.

spells.name: Distant Channel
spells.target: One willing creature within 12 squares with its own SP reserve
spells.effect: Give or receive up to 5 existing SP after paying this spell's casting cost. Both parties agree on the direction and amount. Respect the donor's remaining reserve and the recipient's missing SP.

spells.name: Channel Spell
spells.target: One willing ally within 6 squares; targets measured from that ally
spells.effect: Choose one known Main Action spell from outside the Channeling book costing at most 3 SP. Pay its normal cost plus this spell's 3 SP. The ally spends its Reaction immediately to release it from its position, choosing legal targets; you make any casting roll with your class’s casting attribute. Resolve it once. You remain responsible for any sustain and duration.

spells.name: Directed Siphon
spells.target: One donor and one different recipient within 6 squares, each with its own SP reserve
spells.effect: Transfer 2/3/5 SP from the donor to the recipient. Willing participants may accept the full Strong amount automatically; if either is unwilling, roll once using the least favorable applicable modifiers. Limit transfer to the donor's current SP and recipient's missing SP. Pay the casting cost from your own reserve first.

spells.name: Greater Channel
spells.target: Two different creatures within 6 squares with their own SP reserves
spells.effect: Choose a donor and recipient. Transfer up to 8 existing SP with both parties' consent. If either is unwilling, transfer 3/5/7 instead. Roll once using the least favorable applicable modifiers. Apply the donor's available and recipient's missing SP limits after paying your own casting cost.

spells.name: Lord Channels
spells.target: Self and up to three willing donors within 6 squares
spells.effect: Choose one known Main Action spell from outside the Channeling book costing at most 6 SP. Pay this spell's 5 SP yourself. Each donor spends its Reaction and contributes an agreed amount toward the chosen spell's cost; you pay the remainder. Cast it once with its normal attribute and targets. Contributions pay the spell directly, and you handle the transmitted spell’s duration and Sustain when it requires it.

spells.name: Rechanneling
spells.actionText: Reaction · when a visible spell transfers SP between creatures
spells.trigger: when a visible spell transfers SP between creatures
spells.target: The transfer and a replacement recipient within 6 squares
spells.effect: Add 3/5/7 cancellation progress against the transfer, target 2 plus its casting SP cost. At completion, redirect its stated transferred amount to the replacement recipient, limited by the original donor's available SP and the new recipient's missing SP. Otherwise the original transfer resolves. Pay your own casting cost separately.

spells.name: Power Bridge
spells.target: Two different creatures within 6 squares with their own SP reserves
spells.effect: Choose a donor and recipient. On casting, and on each later upkeep, transfer up to 6 existing SP if both consent, or roll for 2/4/6 if either is unwilling. Use the donor's current reserve and recipient's missing SP as limits. The bridge ends if either moves beyond 6 squares of you. Pay the casting cost once. Each later transfer uses the Sustain Maneuver and costs 0 SP beyond the actual points transferred. Either conscious unwilling participant may spend a Main Action to sever the bridge using the printed hold and escape attributes. A successful escape ends the entire bridge; willing participants may end their participation with a Maneuver.

classes.name: Arcanist
classes.referenceMarkdown:
# Arcanist

*You study the impossible until your hands can give it a shape the world must briefly accept.*

A thread of ash climbs the stair against the draft. You hold up a hand and the company stops. Someone has worked magic here. The ash is going to show you where they stood.

An Arcanist asks what a spell can do in this particular room, with these people in it. An elemental working might change the ground under a fight. A careful ritual might be the answer to a door the company would rather leave intact. Bent Trajectory lets an attack come from an unexpected angle. Study the Pattern suits a reader of workings, and Deliberate Spark is for the caster who sees an advantage in moving friends and foes a little farther apart.

You might savor a clean diagram or love the apprentice who asks the awkward question. What magical shortcut do you refuse to take? What impossible thing would make you put your notes down and try it anyway?

## Rules

**Attributes:** Minimum 0 in Agility, Knowledge. **HP contribution:** +1 at level 1 and per level thereafter.

# Shadow

*You learn the unguarded routes through a world that rarely looks in the right direction.*

The steward keeps the keys on a silver chain. Everyone else is watching the dancers. You are watching the steward’s face each time someone mentions the west gallery.

A Shadow finds opportunities that close as soon as everyone notices them. You shine when the company needs a way in, an opening in a fight, or a conversation that buys somebody else time to act. Fade Behind puts you on the side of the room no one is watching. Blade in the Back rewards the moment an enemy’s attention is elsewhere. Fast Talk gives you something to do when you are the person everyone has turned to look at.

You might love a crowded festival or the privacy of a roof above an empty street. Perhaps you cannot stand a person who confuses discretion with disloyalty. Who knows your real name, and what did they do to earn it?

## Rules

**Attributes:** Minimum 0 in Agility, Guile. **HP contribution:** +2 at level 1 and per level thereafter.

**Casting attribute:** Guile.

**Starting SP contribution:** Twice your positive Guile at creation: 2 × max(0, Guile).

**Starting disciplines:** Choose one of Subterfuge, Marksmanship, Fencing, Athletics. Your culture and background each contribute one other starting discipline. Choose three distinct disciplines across these selections.

**Learning costs:** **1 DP:** Marksmanship, Subterfuge. **2 DP:** Athletics, Mentalism, Divination, Fencing. **3 DP:** Arms, Armor, Guard, Wilderness, Medicine, Craft, Scholarship, Influence, Elements, Life, Invocation, Force, Wards, Spellcraft, Tactics.

Pay the listed price to begin studying another discipline. Then follow the costs and requirements of the path or spellbook you choose.

## Signature development

Choose one signature at each of levels 1, 3 and 7 without spending DP. Choose from your class’s options for that level. Each signature is an ability you can use in its own right. Some offer an additional benefit when you also know another named signature; that benefit appears in the ability’s rules.

You may switch signatures under the ordinary retraining rules. Choose a replacement from your class’s options for the same milestone, then apply any interactions between the signatures you know.


## Level 1 choices

- [Fade Behind](../cards/signature-shadow-fade-behind.md)
- [Fast Talk](../cards/signature-shadow-turn-their-eye.md)

## Level 3 choices

- [Hamstring](../cards/signature-shadow-strike-and-vanish.md)
- [Open the Way](../cards/signature-shadow-open-the-way.md)
- [Read the Room](../cards/signature-shadow-pass-the-guard.md)

## Level 7 choices

- [The Half-Second](../cards/signature-shadow-exploit-confusion.md)
- [One with the Dark](../cards/signature-shadow-unseen-passage.md)
- [The Cutting Word](../cards/signature-shadow-leave-no-pursuit.md)

**Starting coin contribution:** +3 coins. See [starting coins](../starting-coins.md).

# Shepherd

*You listen for the wavering voice and help it find its way back to the others.*

At the end of a bad crossing, one traveler insists they can keep walking. You notice their hands won’t close around the cup. You find somewhere dry to sit and give them time to tell you what happened.

A Shepherd keeps people on their feet and helps them through trouble they cannot face alone. A punishing journey or a fight that leaves someone frightened and hurt gives you plenty to do. Mend makes care an immediate part of danger. Steady Voice suits a Shepherd who can reach a frightened companion through the noise. With Borrowed Shape, you might understand how different a familiar path feels on four feet.

You might love the quiet after a fever breaks, or resent the idea that the slowest traveler should be left behind. Your care may come from faith, a trade, a promise, or long practice. Who cared for you when you could give them nothing in return?

# Unbalanced

*You meet the obstacle with everything you are, and let it discover whether that is enough.*

The barricade has started to give. You hear the beam crack and know there is time for exactly one decision. The others can follow through if you make a gap wide enough.

An Unbalanced brings force to the point where it will matter most. In a crowded fight you can break up the knot around a companion. At a contested passage you can give the company a way through before the chance passes. Go Berserk calls up the fury to stay in a fight. Charge suits the runner who sees a lane through the confusion. Grab and Hurl lets you turn a struggle over footing into an abrupt change of position.

The force you bring can come from anger, joy, or a lifetime of knowing what your body can do. You might enjoy a fair contest and hate seeing strength used to humiliate someone. Who can talk you down when the fight is over?

classes.name: Warden

# Warden

*You read the broken fern, the distant cry and the turn of a fleeing creature. When the road ends, your companions look to you.*

The deer have crossed the stream and circled back along the bank. The people you are following went straight across. You take the company upstream to a shallower crossing and ask them to keep their eyes on the opposite shore.

A Warden reads the land and makes it useful to the people traveling with them. In a pursuit, the ground tells you where to hurry and where to wait. On an expedition, the same eye can find the trail that gets everyone to shelter before dark. Steady Aim suits the hunter who waits for a clear shot. Beast Speech makes the creatures you meet part of the expedition’s story. Twin Strike gives a Warden with two blades a reason to close the distance.

You might love a familiar stretch of river in flood or resent a traveler who leaves trouble for whoever comes next. What place do you know well enough to miss when it changes?

signatures.name: Bent Trajectory
signatures.target: One of your spell attacks; choose one visible, unoccupied square within 6 squares of you before rolling.
signatures.duration: For that spell.
signatures.limits: One signature choice at each of levels 1, 3 and 7.
signatures.effect:
**Action:** Passive · **Attribute:** None — no roll

**Target / range / shape:** One of your spell attacks; choose one visible, unoccupied square within 6 squares of you before rolling.

Choose one of your spell attacks. It can originate from any visible, unoccupied square within 6 squares of you. Determine cover and attack path from that square, but measure range from you. You must know the target’s location. Roll the spell attack normally.

**Duration:** For that spell.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

Use this shaping once on your turn. It changes the origin of an existing spell attack and uses that spell’s action, roll and SP; it is not a separate spell.

flavor: Your spells arrive from an angle no one expected.

signatures.name: Deliberate Spark
signatures.target: One corner of your square; each creature in the four squares that share that corner and are in line of effect.
signatures.duration: Immediate.
signatures.limits: One signature choice at each of levels 1, 3 and 7.
signatures.effect:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None — no roll

**Target / range / shape:** One corner of your square; each creature in the four squares that share that corner and are in line of effect.

Choose a corner of your square and spark a brief flare of gas there. Each creature in the four squares that share that corner, including you, is pushed 2 squares directly away from that corner. A creature in more than one of those squares is pushed once. The spark does not provoke opportunity attacks. Resolve the push as forced movement; normal collision rules apply.

**Duration:** Immediate.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand for casting.

This is a spell costing 0 SP, usable once on your turn. Its casting does not provoke opportunity attacks.

flavor: You turn unstable magic into motion and shelter.

signatures.name: Create a Window
signatures.target: One willing ally during their turn, before their chosen step or attack resolves. Choose two visible, unoccupied squares within 6 squares of you.
signatures.duration: Until the end of the ally’s turn.
signatures.limits: One signature choice at each of levels 1, 3 and 7.
signatures.effect:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One willing ally during their turn, before their chosen step or attack resolves. Choose two visible, unoccupied squares within 6 squares of you.

The two squares become connected windows until the end of the ally’s turn. The ally can use the windows once at any point during their turn, either to move through one and out the other, spending 1 square of movement, or to make one attack through one window, measuring range and cover from the other. The ally must be able to see the window they use. The windows vanish at the end of the ally’s turn. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.

**Duration:** Until the end of the ally’s turn.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand for casting.

This is a spell costing 0 SP. The windows give the ally a route for its own movement or attack.

**Frequency:** Once per round.

signatures.duration: The triggering damage and immediate push.
signatures.limits: One signature choice at each of levels 1, 3 and 7.
signatures.effect:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (roll the triggering defense normally)

**Target / range / shape:** Your defense against a spell, declared before rolling.

Once per scene, roll the defense and determine the spell’s damage before your resistance and other reductions. Prevent that spell event’s damage to you. Its other effects still apply. Choose a corner of your square; push each creature in a square sharing that corner and in line of effect, including yourself, directly away from that corner by the prevented damage amount, to a maximum of 3 squares. A creature spanning several squares is pushed once. Resolve Stability and collisions normally. This is a magical defensive effect, not another casting.

**Duration:** The triggering damage and immediate push.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

**Duration:** The triggering damage and immediate push.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

signatures.name: Folded Aegis
signatures.target: Self.
signatures.duration: 2 hours.
signatures.limits: One signature choice at each of levels 1, 3 and 7.
signatures.effect:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self.

For 2 hours, you are wrapped in magical heavy armor. You gain physical resistance 3, fire resistance 3 and cold resistance 3. Use the highest matching resistance for each damage type, to the normal cap of 3. The armor is weightless and needs no armor training.

**Duration:** 2 hours.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand for casting.

This is a spell costing 0 SP, usable once between safe overnight rests. Its duration is fixed and requires no Sustain. Cancellation ends the armor; the cancellation progress target is 2.

flavor: You turn unstable magic into motion and shelter.

**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** Brawn

**Target / range / shape:** Self, then one enemy within melee reach.

Once per scene, move up to 2 squares toward a visible enemy, following ordinary opportunity attack rules. Make one Basic Melee attack with your melee weapon against a creature you can reach. **Equipment / acquisition:** A ready melee weapon.

signatures.name: Measured Guard
signatures.target: Self, before a defense against an adjacent enemy.
signatures.duration: The triggering defense and immediate counterattack.
signatures.limits: One signature choice at each of levels 1, 3 and 7.
signatures.effect:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self, before a defense against an adjacent enemy.

Gain 1 Boon to the defense. After the attack resolves, if the defense was Strong and the attacker is within your reach, make a Basic Melee attack against that attacker. This counterattack is part of the Reaction and does not use your Main Action.

**Duration:** The triggering defense and immediate counterattack.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

You must wield a melee weapon to use this guard and counterattack. A granted counterattack cannot trigger another granted attack.

flavor: Your guard makes an opening of the stroke meant for you.

signatures.duration: Immediate.
signatures.limits: One signature choice at each of levels 1, 3 and 7.
signatures.effect:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Brawn

**Target / range / shape:** All creatures adjacent to you, including allies. You must be wielding a melee weapon.

Make one Brawn roll using the least favorable net Boons/Banes among the targets. On a Weak result, deal 1 physical damage to each creature adjacent to you. On a Standard result, deal 1 physical damage and push each creature 1 square directly away from you. On a Strong result, deal 1 physical damage and push each creature 2 squares directly away from you. Resolve collisions normally.

**Duration:** Immediate.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

**Frequency:** Once on your turn.

flavor: Your blade finds room in the press of bodies.

signatures.duration: Immediate pursuit and attack.
signatures.equipment: A melee weapon is required for the attack; grants one ordinary melee weapon, Bulk 1, if absent.

signatures.effect:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** A visible enemy within 2 squares when it begins voluntary movement.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A melee weapon is required for the attack; grants one ordinary melee weapon, Bulk 1, if absent.

Use this Reaction once per scene. Follow legal movement routes and end in a supported free square; barriers still obstruct pursuit.

signatures.name: Make It Last
signatures.target: One ordinary item you own within reach.
signatures.duration: Indefinite; no Sustain.
signatures.equipment: Suitable tools and the actual ordinary item.
signatures.limits: One signature choice at each of levels 1, 3 and 7.
signatures.effect:
**Action:** Ritual — 1 hour · **Attribute:** None

**Target / range / shape:** One ordinary item you own within reach.

**Magic:** Bound-item spell · **SP:** 1

Pay 1 SP and bind one item with a property chosen when bound: a lamp gives controllable ordinary torchlight; a tool returns to its bearer’s empty hand with a Maneuver from within 3 squares along a clear path; or a shield lets its bearer spend a Reaction once per scene to reduce one attack’s damage by 1 after rolling defense, respecting the attack’s minimum damage. You can have one bound item. A binding lasts until you end or replace it, even if the item is lent or lost. Cancellation target 3 ends its magic but leaves the ordinary item and occupied binding; restore the magic with a new ritual and SP. Lending or re-binding an item does not refresh its limited use.

**Duration:** Indefinite; no Sustain.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Suitable tools and the actual ordinary item.

flavor: Your careful work leaves useful magic in familiar tools.

**Action:** Main Action · One minute · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Time:** One minute.

**Target / range / shape:** Self and up to three allies who can hear and understand you.

Spend one minute forming a plan from the evidence and observations available. State the plan. The DA confirms what is true, what remains uncertain, and one contradiction or risk. You and each chosen ally gain 2 Boons to your next roll that directly follows the plan.

**Duration:** The plan and its stated limits remain known; each Boon expires when used or at the end of the scene.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

Keep one plan at a time. A new plan replaces the previous plan and its unused Boons.

**Frequency:** Once per scene.

Study the foe. Until the start of your next turn, your next weapon attack against it may use Knowledge instead of its ordinary attribute. Use that attack’s actual range, weapon requirements, damage and effects. You may study once on your turn; a new study replaces the previous one.

Once per scene, after resolving that studied weapon attack, reduce one of the target’s existing resistances by 1, minimum 0, until scene end. Each target can suffer this reduction only once from Shatter the Guard, regardless of source. Immunity is unchanged.

**Duration:** Study until the start of your next turn; resistance reduction until scene end.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

If you also know Predict the Motion, its defense benefit applies while this study lasts.

signatures.name: Lead the Way
signatures.target: Self; any willing allies within 3 squares who can see or hear you.
signatures.duration: During your movement.
signatures.limits: One signature choice at each of levels 1, 3 and 7.
signatures.effect:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self; any willing allies within 3 squares who can see or hear you.

When you move using your Speed, any willing ally within 3 squares who can see or hear you may move with you at the same time, following your path, up to the distance you move, to a maximum of 2 squares. An ally who comes within 3 squares during your movement may join for the remainder of that movement. The allies spend no movement. This movement follows normal opportunity attack rules.

**Duration:** During your movement.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

Spend the Maneuver before beginning the linked movement. Allies follow legal routes along your path and end in separate legal squares.

**Frequency:** Once on your turn.

flavor: You show the way through danger with your own movement.

signatures.target: Self and one adjacent willing ally.
signatures.duration: Until your next turn or adjacency is lost.
signatures.limits: One signature choice at each of levels 1, 3 and 7.
signatures.effect:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None

**Target / range / shape:** Self and one adjacent willing ally.

**Duration:** Until your next turn or adjacency is lost.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

flavor: You give frightened companions a place to stand together.

signatures.target: Every enemy within 5 squares that can hear you.
signatures.duration: Conditions use normal decay.
signatures.limits: One signature choice at each of levels 1, 3 and 7.
signatures.effect:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** Guile

**Target / range / shape:** Every enemy within 5 squares that can hear you.

Make one Guile roll and apply the result to each target. On a Weak result, apply Frightened 1. On a Standard result, apply Frightened 1 and Dazed 1. On a Strong result, apply Frightened 2 and Dazed 1.

**Duration:** Conditions use normal decay.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

Use once per scene. Roll using the least favorable applicable Boons/Banes. Apply hearing requirements and condition immunities normally.

signatures.name: Out of Body
signatures.target: Self.
signatures.duration: Until the end of your turn.
signatures.limits: One signature choice at each of levels 1, 3 and 7.
signatures.effect:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self.

Your body falls prone and cannot act, move or take Reactions. It has 3 defense Banes. Your spirit appears in your square or an adjacent free square.

The spirit has Speed 5, can speak, can pass through nonmagical solid objects and creatures, and is not a legal target for ordinary attacks. It cannot attack, cast spells, use equipment or physically interact with objects. Its movement does not provoke opportunity attacks. Magical attacks can target it; resolve them against your normal defenses, and damage to the spirit is damage to your body. If your body drops to 0 HP, the projection ends.

At the end of your turn, choose one:

- **Snap Back:** Your spirit returns to your body.
- **Manifest:** Your body appears in the spirit’s square or the nearest free square that is not separated from your body by a solid barrier, prone. The projection ends.

If no legal Manifest square exists, you can only Snap Back.

**Duration:** Until the end of your turn.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand for casting.

This is a spell costing 0 SP, usable once per scene. Attacks explicitly described as magical and spells may target the spirit; ordinary attacks target your body instead.

flavor: The spirits lend you words, perspective and remembered lives.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Until the end of your turn.

signatures.name: A Door Where There Wasn’t
signatures.target: Self; one nonmagical barrier within reach.
signatures.duration: Until you pass through or the end of your next turn.
signatures.limits: One signature choice at each of levels 1, 3 and 7.
signatures.effect:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self; one nonmagical barrier within reach.

A door-sized opening appears in the barrier. Only you and your worn or carried gear can pass through it. The opening closes immediately after you pass through or at the end of your next turn.

**Duration:** Until you pass through or the end of your next turn.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand for casting.

This is a spell costing 1 SP, usable once per scene. The barrier can be at most 1 square thick, and you must see a safe, empty destination on its far side. Movement through the opening uses ordinary movement. Cancellation target 3 closes the opening.

flavor: You make the familiar world answer in an unfamiliar voice.

signatures.name: The Price Deferred
signatures.target: Self, when you would receive your third death failure.
signatures.duration: Until the start of your next turn.
signatures.limits: One signature choice at each of levels 1, 3 and 7.
signatures.effect:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None

**Target / range / shape:** Self, when you would receive your third death failure.

**Magic:** Magical pact reprieve (not a spell)

Once between safe overnight rests, delay your death until the start of your next turn. You remain at 0 HP with three failures and make no further death rolls during this delay. Stabilization or healing above 0 clears the danger under ordinary recovery rules. At the start of your next turn, if you still have three failures, you die unless you spend Grit immediately. You can use this specific Reaction while Dying, even if unconscious.

**Duration:** Until the start of your next turn.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

flavor: A supernatural compact lends your purpose a voice and a weapon.

signatures.name: Borrowed Life
signatures.target: Self.
signatures.duration: Until scene end.
signatures.limits: One signature choice at each of levels 1, 3 and 7.
signatures.effect:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** None

**Target / range / shape:** Self.

**Magic:** Spell · **SP:** 0

Once between safe overnight rests, invite a spirit’s expertise for the scene. Choose one named tool practice or one specific noncombat objective approach, such as interpreting old boundary stones. Gain 3 Boons to rolls using that expertise. The spirit lends mannerisms and speech while you remain in control. Use your own equipment and learned capabilities; the expertise is not weapon training or a spell repertoire.

**Duration:** Until scene end.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand.

**Duration:** The triggering attack.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

signatures.target: An enemy that damaged one of your allies this scene.

signatures.effect:

**Target / range / shape:** An enemy that damaged one of your allies this scene.

signatures.action: Passive modifier to a melee weapon attack
signatures.target: An enemy that damaged one of your allies this scene.
signatures.duration: The attack and immediate push; Dazed uses normal decay.
signatures.equipment: The actual melee weapon required by the attack.
signatures.limits: One signature choice at each of levels 1, 3 and 7.
signatures.effect:
**Action:** Passive modifier to a melee weapon attack · **Attribute:** Use that attack’s attribute

**Target / range / shape:** An enemy that damaged one of your allies this scene.

Once on your turn, declare this modifier and pay 1 SP before a melee weapon attack against that enemy. Add 1/2/3 radiant damage to the attack on Weak/Standard/Strong. On Standard or Strong, also push the target 1 square directly away from you. On Strong, also apply Dazed 1. Resolve each damage component’s resistance, then apply the minimum once to the whole attack. Resolve Stability, collisions and condition immunity normally.

**Duration:** The attack and immediate push; Dazed uses normal decay.

**Equipment / acquisition:** The actual melee weapon required by the attack.

This magical weapon modifier is not a separate spell casting and requires no free hand beyond the weapon’s requirements.

signatures.name: Take the Wound
signatures.target: One ally within 5 squares.
signatures.duration: Immediate. Attached conditions follow their usual timing.
signatures.limits: One signature choice at each of levels 1, 3 and 7.
signatures.effect:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One ally within 5 squares.

Trigger: an ally within 5 squares would take damage that reduces it to 0 HP. Take the entire damage event instead, applying your own weaknesses and resistances once. The ally takes none of that event’s damage or attached conditions; you take its attached conditions. If you fall to 0, resolve your own Dying procedure.

**Duration:** Immediate. Attached conditions follow their usual timing.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

Use once per scene. A triggering attack may be redirected only once; resolve your own resistance once after redirection.

flavor: You put yourself between another person and the worst of the blow.

signatures.name: Sheltering Hands
signatures.target: Self or one living creature you touch.
signatures.duration: Healing and stabilization immediate; defense Boons until used or your next turn.
signatures.equipment: A free hand touching the healing recipient.
signatures.limits: One signature choice at each of levels 1, 3 and 7.
signatures.effect:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Class

**Target / range / shape:** Self or one living creature you touch.

Restore 3/5/7 HP on Weak/Standard/Strong. Apply the recipient’s Life resistance, minimum 1 healing when HP is missing, and its maximum HP. Healing above 0 ends Dying and clears death marks normally. **Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand touching the healing recipient.

This is a spell costing 1 SP.

If you also know Restoring Hands, apply its condition reduction of 1/1/2 on Weak/Standard/Strong instead of this signature’s Strong-only reduction. This remains one healing action, not two castings.

signatures.name: Radiant Threshold
signatures.target: A straight line starting from a point you can see within 5 squares.
signatures.duration: Until the start of your next turn.
signatures.limits: One signature choice at each of levels 1, 3 and 7.
signatures.effect:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Class

**Target / range / shape:** A straight line starting from a point you can see within 5 squares.

Roll your class’s casting attribute. Weak: 3 squares long; 1 radiant damage. Standard: 5 squares long; 2 radiant damage. Strong: 7 squares long; 3 radiant damage. The line is 1 square wide and lasts until the start of your next turn. You and allies you choose when you create it are unaffected. A creature takes the damage when the line appears in its square, when it enters a square of the line, or when it starts its turn there. A creature can take this damage only once per round. The line does not block movement.

**Duration:** Until the start of your next turn.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand for casting.

This is a spell costing 2 SP, usable once per scene. You may have one threshold at a time; creating another ends it. Each creature takes its zone damage at most once per round. Damage dealt by occupying/crossing the persistent zone is non-attack damage and can be reduced to 0.

signatures.target: Self.
signatures.duration: Immediate; Hidden uses its normal duration.
signatures.limits: One signature choice at each of levels 1, 3 and 7.
signatures.effect:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** Agility

**Target / range / shape:** Self.

Disengage. Then attempt to Hide with 1 Boon, even if you are currently observed, provided you have cover or obscurement. You still make the ordinary Hide attempt. If you succeed, you are Hidden until you attack, are revealed, or the concealment ends.

**Duration:** Immediate; Hidden uses its normal duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

**Frequency:** Once on your turn.

flavor: You leave danger looking at the place where you used to stand.

signatures.name: Fast Talk
signatures.target: One creature within 5 squares that can hear and understand you.
signatures.duration: Immediate progress; the negotiation persists.
signatures.limits: One signature choice at each of levels 1, 3 and 7.
signatures.effect:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** Guile

**Target / range / shape:** One creature within 5 squares that can hear and understand you.

State the social goal you are pursuing and what you want the target to do. Make a Guile roll. The result adds progress toward that goal: Weak: 2 progress. Standard: 3 progress. Strong: 5 progress. The DA sets the progress target before the roll. When the total reaches it, the target agrees within its wants and limits. This does not compel self-harm, betrayal, or a change to its loyalties.

**Duration:** Immediate progress; the negotiation persists.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

Repeated attempts toward the same objective require a new meaningful contribution; use the DA’s objective and progress rules.

flavor: Your words turn a room before your enemies can settle it.

signatures.name: Mend
signatures.target: One living ally within 3 squares.
signatures.duration: Immediate.
signatures.limits: One signature choice at each of levels 1, 3 and 7.
signatures.effect:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Class

**Target / range / shape:** One living ally within 3 squares.

pay 1 SP before rolling. You must have enough SP to pay this cost. Requires a free hand. Roll your class’s casting attribute. Weak: restore 3 HP. Standard: restore 6 HP. Strong: restore 9 HP, and the target may stand without spending movement. Reduce the restored amount by the target's Life resistance, to a minimum of 1 if HP is missing, and never exceed maximum HP. A Dying or stabilized living creature can receive this healing. This does not erase scars or restore the dead.

**Duration:** Immediate.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand.

This is a spell; use its printed 1 SP cost and ordinary casting rules.

flavor: You call living strength back into those who need it.

signatures.name: Steady Voice
signatures.target: One ally within 3 squares that can hear and understand you.
signatures.duration: Immediate.
signatures.limits: One signature choice at each of levels 1, 3 and 7.
signatures.effect:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** Guile

**Target / range / shape:** One ally within 3 squares that can hear and understand you.

Make a Guile roll. Choose Frightened or Dazed on the target. Weak: reduce that condition by 1. Standard: reduce it by 1, and the target gains 1 Boon to its next roll to resist fear or Daze. Strong: reduce it by 2, and the target gains 1 Boon to its next roll to resist fear or Daze. If the target has neither condition, it gains the Boon on a Standard or Strong result.

**Duration:** Immediate.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

An unused Boon expires at the start of your next turn. This reassuring voice is an ordinary ability, not a spell.

flavor: Your steady presence gathers scattered courage.

signatures.name: Borrowed Shape
signatures.target: Self.
signatures.duration: Fixed 10 minutes; no Sustain.
signatures.equipment: A free hand to cast before transforming.
signatures.limits: One signature choice at each of levels 1, 3 and 7.
signatures.effect:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** None

**Target / range / shape:** Self.

**Magic:** Spell · **SP:** 1

Once per scene, assume the appearance of a familiar Small or Medium ground beast for 10 minutes. Keep your HP, attributes, conditions, resources and Speed. Your equipment melds and provides no effects or resistance. Your form has physical resistance 1 and a natural attack: Main Action, Brawn, adjacent target, 2/3/5 physical damage on Weak/Standard/Strong. You speak only animal calls and cannot cast spells or use equipment. Return to your own shape with a Maneuver or automatically at 0 HP. Changing form never restores HP.

**Duration:** Fixed 10 minutes; no Sustain.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand to cast before transforming.

flavor: The wild lends you another shape without taking away your own life.

signatures.name: The Fold
signatures.target: A 3 × 3 area centered on a point within 5 squares.
signatures.duration: Until the end of your next turn; sustained one round at a time.
signatures.limits: One signature choice at each of levels 1, 3 and 7.
signatures.effect:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** A 3 × 3 area centered on a point within 5 squares.

Call divine energy. The area becomes the Fold until the end of your next turn. You and each ally in the Fold gain 1 Boon to all rolls. The Fold does not move. As a Maneuver on a later turn, you can sustain the Fold until the end of your next turn. Sustaining costs the Maneuver and requires you to be able to act.

**Duration:** Until the end of your next turn; sustained one round at a time.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand for casting.

This is a spell costing 0 SP. Sustain with a Maneuver and 0 SP, for up to 1 minute; it occupies your one sustained-spell allowance.

**Frequency:** Once per scene to create; later upkeep spends a Maneuver.

**Target / range / shape:** Two willing creatures within 5 squares, one donor and one recipient. You can be either.

Move up to 6 HP from the donor to the recipient. The donor must remain above 0 HP. The recipient cannot exceed maximum HP. Move the same amount out of the donor’s HP and into the recipient’s HP, ignoring Life resistance. If the recipient rises above 0 HP, clear both death roll tallies and end Dying and HP-caused unconsciousness.

**Duration:** Immediate.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand for casting.

This is a spell costing 0 SP, usable once on your turn. The donor must stay above 0 HP. Transfer only existing HP into missing HP, ignoring Life resistance on this transfer; the amount removed equals the amount restored.

flavor: Your steady presence gathers scattered courage.

signatures.name: Great Shape
signatures.target: Self.
signatures.duration: Fixed 10 minutes; no Sustain.
signatures.equipment: A free hand to cast before transforming.
signatures.limits: One signature choice at each of levels 1, 3 and 7.
signatures.effect:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** None

**Target / range / shape:** Self.

Once per scene, transform for 10 minutes into a familiar Small, Medium or Large ground beast, or a Small flying beast. Choose a legal space large enough for the form. Keep your HP, attributes, conditions, resources and Speed, and gain physical resistance 1. Your equipment melds and provides no effects or resistance. You speak only animal calls and cannot cast spells or use equipment. Return to your own shape with a Maneuver or automatically at 0 HP. Changing form never restores HP.

A Small or Medium ground beast has a natural Main Action attack using Brawn against an adjacent target for 2/3/5 physical damage. A Large ground beast has a natural Main Action attack using Brawn against an adjacent target for 3/4/6 physical damage; Strong also pushes the target 1 square directly away. A Small flying beast gains fly Speed equal to your Speed and a natural Main Action attack using Brawn against an adjacent target for 2/3/5 physical damage. Returning to your own form while airborne leaves you subject to falling normally.

**Duration:** Fixed 10 minutes; no Sustain.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand to cast before transforming.

This is a spell costing 1 SP. If you also know Borrowed Shape or Shape of the Wild, all share the same once-per-scene transformation use. Shape of the Wild’s adaptation is available only if you also know that signature.

flavor: The wild lends you another shape without taking away your own life.

signatures.name: Go Berserk
signatures.target: Self.
signatures.duration: Until the end of the scene, or until you end it.
signatures.limits: One signature choice at each of levels 1, 3 and 7.
signatures.effect:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self.

Enter a rage until the end of the scene. While raging, you gain 1 Boon to attack rolls, have 1 Bane to defense rolls, and gain physical resistance 1. You can end the rage at will. It also ends if you fall unconscious or enter Dying.

**Duration:** Until the end of the scene, or until you end it.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

**Frequency:** Once per scene.

flavor: Your fury turns pain and peril into a reason to keep moving.

signatures.name: Charge
signatures.target: One creature at least 2 squares away and within your Speed, in a straight line.
signatures.duration: Immediate.
signatures.limits: One signature choice at each of levels 1, 3 and 7.
signatures.effect:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Brawn

**Target / range / shape:** One creature at least 2 squares away and within your Speed, in a straight line.

Move up to your Speed in a straight line toward the target. This movement provokes normally. If you end adjacent to it, make a Brawn roll against it. Weak: 2 physical damage, and push it 1 square. Standard: 3 physical damage, push it 2 squares, and it is Prone. Strong: 5 physical damage, push it 3 squares, and it is Prone. Resolve collisions normally. If you cannot move at least 2 squares, you cannot use this ability.

**Duration:** Immediate.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

Movement used in the approach spends your remaining movement for the turn, rather than granting a second full Speed allowance.

flavor: You strike the line with the force of your whole approach.

signatures.name: Grab and Hurl
signatures.target: One adjacent creature your size or smaller.
signatures.duration: Immediate; Grappled and Prone use their normal rules.
signatures.limits: One signature choice at each of levels 1, 3 and 7.
signatures.effect:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Brawn

**Target / range / shape:** One adjacent creature your size or smaller.

Make a Brawn roll against the target. Weak: it has Grappled 1. Standard: throw it up to 2 squares in a direction you choose; it lands Prone. Strong: throw it up to 3 squares in a direction you choose; it lands Prone and takes 2 physical damage. Resolve collisions normally. The throw ends any grapple from this ability.

**Duration:** Immediate; Grappled and Prone use their normal rules.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

Requires a free hand and a target your Size or smaller. A control-only Weak result deals no damage; it does not acquire an attack damage minimum.

flavor: Your hands turn bodies and momentum into weapons.

signatures.name: Pain Feeds the Fire
signatures.target: Self.
signatures.duration: Rage until scene end or until ended; damage-triggered Boon until your next attack or the end of your next turn.
signatures.limits: One signature choice at each of levels 1, 3 and 7.
signatures.effect:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self.

Enter a rage until the end of the scene. While raging, gain 1 Boon to attack rolls, 1 Bane to defense rolls, and physical resistance 1. You can end the rage at will. It also ends if you fall unconscious or enter Dying.

When an enemy damages you during this rage, gain 1 Boon to your next attack before the end of your next turn. Repeated damage does not accumulate these Boons. Damage you or an ally deliberately deal to you, and hazards you deliberately enter to hurt yourself, do not trigger it. Hostile forced movement into a hazard does trigger it.

**Duration:** Rage until scene end or until ended; damage-triggered Boon until your next attack or the end of your next turn.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

signatures.name: Rampage
signatures.target: Self; a straight line up to your Speed.
signatures.duration: Immediate.
signatures.limits: One signature choice at each of levels 1, 3 and 7.
signatures.effect:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Brawn

**Target / range / shape:** Self; a straight line up to your Speed.

This ability consumes your Main Action and your movement for the turn. Move up to your Speed in a straight line. Each enemy within 1 square of your path takes 2 physical damage and is pushed 1 square directly away from the path. Then make a Brawn roll against one enemy adjacent to you at the end of the movement. Weak: 3 physical damage. Standard: 4 physical damage, and it is Prone. Strong: 6 physical damage, and it is Prone. If you cannot move at least 2 squares in a straight line, you cannot use this ability. You cannot move again after the charge.

**Duration:** Immediate.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

A creature takes the path damage at most once per use. The endpoint attack is a separate damage event.

**Frequency:** Once per scene.

flavor: You strike the line with the force of your whole approach.

signatures.name: Over the Top
signatures.target: One willing ally your size or smaller within reach.
signatures.duration: Immediate.
signatures.equipment: A free hand; the ally needs a ready melee weapon or free hand for its Basic Melee attack.
signatures.limits: One signature choice at each of levels 1, 3 and 7.
signatures.effect:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One willing ally your size or smaller within reach.

Throw the ally up to 4 squares in a direction you choose, ignoring difficult terrain and passing over occupied squares. The ally must land standing in a free square. If it lands adjacent to an enemy, it may immediately make one Basic Melee attack against that enemy with 1 Boon. That attack is part of your action, not the ally's turn. The ally takes no damage from the throw.

**Duration:** Immediate.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand; the ally needs a ready melee weapon or free hand for its Basic Melee attack.

Use once per scene. The landing square must be legal and empty; a granted attack cannot grant further attacks.

flavor: Your hands turn bodies and momentum into weapons.
